title.raw: 卷三百七十七 列傳第一百三十六 向子諲 陳規 季陵 盧知原 陳桷 李璆 李朴 王庠 王衣 Volume 377 Biographies 136: Xiang ZiYin, Chen Gui, Ji Ling, Lu Zhiyuan, Chen Jue, Li Qiu, Li Pu, Wang Xiang, Wang Yi

sentences.zh: 向子諲

translations.literal: Xiang Ziyin
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Ziyin

sentences.zh: 向子諲，字伯恭，臨江人，敏中玄孫，欽聖憲肅皇后再從侄也。

translations.literal: Xiang Ziyin, styled Bogong, was a native of Linjiang, the great-great-grandson of Minzhong and a grandnephew once removed of Empress Qinsheng Xiansu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Ziyin, styled Bogong, was from Linjiang. He was the great-great-grandson of Minzhong and a grandnephew of Empress Qinsheng Xiansu.

sentences.zh: 元符三年，以后復辟恩，補假承奉郎，三遷知開封府咸平縣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfu, through the empress's grace for restoring the imperial residence, he was appointed acting Gentleman for Court Service, and after three promotions became magistrate of Xianping County in Kaifeng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Yuanfu era, he received an appointment as acting Gentleman for Court Service through the empress's grace for the restoration of the imperial residence, and after three promotions became magistrate of Xianping County in Kaifeng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 豪民席勢犯法，獄具上，尹盛章方以獄空覬賞，卻不受，子諲以聞，詔許自論決，章大怒，劾以他事勒停。

translations.literal: A powerful local bully relied on influence to break the law; when the case was complete and submitted, Prefect Sheng Zhang was just then hoping for reward because the prisons were empty and refused to accept it. Ziyin reported this, and an edict permitted him to decide the case himself. Zhang was greatly angered and impeached him on other grounds, forcing his suspension.
translations.idiomatic: When a powerful local bully used his influence to break the law, Ziyin completed the case and submitted it, but Prefect Sheng Zhang—hoping for a reward for empty prisons—refused to accept it. Ziyin reported the matter, and the court authorized him to decide the case himself. Zhang was furious and impeached him on other grounds, forcing his suspension.

sentences.zh: 宣和初，復官，除江淮發運司主管文字。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xuanhe era, his office was restored and he was appointed chief clerk of the Jiang-Huai Transport Commission.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xuanhe era, his office was restored and he was appointed chief clerk of the Jiang-Huai Transport Commission.

sentences.zh: 淮南仍歲旱，漕不通，有欲浚河與江、淮平者，內侍主其議，無敢可否，發運司檄子諲行。

translations.literal: Huainan suffered drought year after year, and grain transport was blocked. Some proposed dredging the canal to level it with the Yangzi and Huai, and a eunuch championed the plan; no one dared approve or reject it. The Transport Commission ordered Ziyin to go and investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan suffered drought year after year, blocking grain transport. Some proposed dredging the canal to bring it level with the Yangzi and Huai, and a eunuch championed the idea; no one dared approve or reject it. The Transport Commission dispatched Ziyin to investigate.

sentences.zh: 子諲言：「自江至淮數百里，河高江、淮數丈，而欲浚之使平，決不可。

translations.literal: Ziyin said: "From the Yangzi to the Huai is several hundred li, and the canal is several zhang higher than the Yangzi and Huai; to dredge it level is absolutely impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin said, "From the Yangzi to the Huai is several hundred li, and the canal stands several zhang above the Yangzi and Huai. To dredge it level is absolutely impossible.

sentences.zh: 曩有司三日一啟閘，復作澳儲水，故水不乏。

translations.literal: Formerly the officials opened the sluices once every three days and also built basins to store water, so water was never lacking.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly officials opened the sluices once every three days and built storage basins, so water was never lacking.

sentences.zh: 比年行直達之法，加以應奉往來，啟閉無節，堰閘率不存。

translations.literal: In recent years the direct-transport method was implemented, and with tribute missions coming and going, sluices were opened and closed without rule, and dams and gates were mostly gone.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the direct-transport system was implemented; with tribute missions coming and going, sluices were opened and closed without restraint, and dams and gates were mostly gone.

sentences.zh: 今復故制，嚴禁約，則無患。」

translations.literal: If the old system is restored now and strict prohibitions enforced, there will be no trouble."
translations.idiomatic: If we restore the old system now and enforce strict regulations, there will be no trouble."

sentences.zh: 使者用其言，漕復通，進秩一等。

translations.literal: The commissioner adopted his advice, transport was restored, and he was promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner adopted his advice, transport was restored, and he was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 召對，除淮南轉運判官。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience, he was appointed transport intendant of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for audience, he was appointed transport intendant of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 以戶部奏諸路起發上供不及數，降一官。

translations.literal: Because the Ministry of Revenue reported that various circuits failed to meet tribute quotas, he was demoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Because the Ministry of Revenue reported that various circuits failed to meet tribute quotas, he was demoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 遷直龍圖閣、江淮發運副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Direct Associate of the Longtu Hall and deputy transport commissioner of the Jiang-Huai route.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Direct Associate of the Longtu Hall and deputy transport commissioner of the Jiang-Huai route.

sentences.zh: 子諲言：「去歲劉順奉淵聖蠟詔，命監司帥守募兵勤王，臣即鏤板遍檄所部，而六路之間漠無應者；

translations.literal: Ziyin said: "Last year Liu Shun received the wax-sealed edict of the Deposed Sage Emperor, ordering circuit commissioners and prefectural commanders to raise troops to rescue the throne; I immediately had it carved on boards and dispatched proclamations throughout my jurisdiction, yet among the six circuits there was not a single response;
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin said, "Last year Liu Shun received the wax-sealed edict of the Deposed Sage Emperor ordering circuit commissioners and prefectural commanders to raise troops to rescue the throne. I immediately had it carved on boards and dispatched proclamations throughout my jurisdiction, yet among the six circuits there was not a single response;

sentences.zh: 間有團結起發者，類如兒戲，姑以避責而已。

translations.literal: where groups were mustered and sent out, it was like child's play, merely to evade responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: where groups were mustered and sent out, it was like child's play, merely to evade responsibility.

sentences.zh: 惟淮東一路，臣親率諸司，粗成紀律。

translations.literal: Only on the Huaidong route did I personally lead the various offices and roughly establish discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Only on the Huaidong route did I personally lead the various offices and roughly establish discipline.

sentences.zh: 然諸司猶有占吝錢物，莫肯供億，殊不念君父幽處圍城之中，臣當時恨無利刃以加其頸。

translations.literal: Yet the various offices still hoarded money and goods and would not supply them, utterly heedless that the sovereign and father languished within a besieged city; at the time I wished I had a sharp blade to put to their necks.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the various offices still hoarded money and goods and would not supply them, utterly heedless that the sovereign and father languished within a besieged city; at the time I wished I had a sharp blade to put to their necks.

sentences.zh: 今京城失守，二帝播遷，儻賞罰不行，恐金人再為邊患，陛下復欲起天下之兵，而諸路翫習故常，恬不知畏，將何恃以濟艱難哉？

translations.literal: Now the capital has fallen and the two emperors have been driven into exile; if rewards and punishments are not enforced, I fear the Jurchens will again become a border threat. When Your Majesty again wishes to raise troops from all under Heaven, the various circuits will cling to old habits and know no fear—what will you rely on to overcome hardship?
translations.idiomatic: Now the capital has fallen and the two emperors have been driven into exile. If rewards and punishments are not enforced, I fear the Jurchens will again threaten the borders. When Your Majesty again wishes to raise troops from all under Heaven, the various circuits will cling to old habits and know no fear—what will you rely on to overcome hardship?

sentences.zh: 願明詔大臣，按劾諸路監司向承蠟詔廢格不勤王，及名為勤王而稽緩者，悉加顯黜。」

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will clearly order the great ministers to investigate and impeach circuit commissioners who received the wax-sealed edict but shelved it and did not march to rescue the throne, and those who claimed to march but delayed—all should be clearly dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will clearly order the great ministers to investigate and impeach circuit commissioners who received the wax-sealed edict but shelved it and did not march to rescue the throne, and those who claimed to march but delayed—all should be clearly dismissed."

sentences.zh: 命諸路提刑司究實以聞。

translations.literal: An order was issued for the judicial commissioners of each circuit to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued for the judicial commissioners of each circuit to investigate and report.

sentences.zh: 九月，子諲罷，以素為李綱所善，故黃潛善斥之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Ziyin was dismissed, because he had long been favored by Li Gang, and so Huang Qianshan removed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Ziyin was dismissed, because he had long been favored by Li Gang, and so Huang Qianshan removed him.

sentences.zh: 明年，知襲慶府，道梗不能赴。

translations.literal: The next year he was appointed prefect of Xiqing Prefecture, but the roads were blocked and he could not go.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was appointed prefect of Xiqing Prefecture, but the roads were blocked and he could not go.

sentences.zh: 初，邦昌為平章軍國事，子諲乞致仕避之，坐言者降三官，起復知潭州。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Zhang Bangchang served as Grand Councilor of State and Military Affairs, Ziyin requested retirement to avoid him; because of remonstrators he was demoted three ranks, then recalled to serve as prefect of Tanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Zhang Bangchang served as Grand Councilor of State and Military Affairs, Ziyin requested retirement to avoid him; because of remonstrators he was demoted three ranks, then recalled to serve as prefect of Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 禁卒為亂，縱火掠市，出瀏陽縣，子諲遣通判孟彥卿等追及攸縣平之。

translations.literal: Garrison soldiers mutinied, set fires and plundered the market, and went out to Liuyang County; Ziyin sent Vice Prefect Meng Yanqing and others to pursue them to You County and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison soldiers mutinied, set fires and plundered the market, and went out to Liuyang County; Ziyin sent Vice Prefect Meng Yanqing and others to pursue them to You County and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 金人破江西，移兵湖南，子諲聞警報，率軍民以死守。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens broke through Jiangxi and shifted troops to Hunan, Ziyin heard the alarm and led soldiers and civilians in a death-defying defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens broke through Jiangxi and shifted troops to Hunan, Ziyin heard the alarm and led soldiers and civilians in a death-defying defense.

sentences.zh: 宗室成忠郎聿之隸東壁，子諲巡城，顧謂曰：「君宗室，不可效此曹苟簡。」

translations.literal: The imperial clansman Chengzhong Lang Yu, assigned to the eastern wall, was on the wall when Ziyin made the rounds; turning to him he said: "You are of the imperial clan—you must not imitate these men in their lax ways."
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clansman Chengzhong Lang Yu, assigned to the eastern wall, was on the wall when Ziyin made the rounds; turning to him he said, "You are of the imperial clan—you must not imitate these men in their lax ways."

sentences.zh: 聿之感激流涕。

translations.literal: Yu was moved to tears.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was moved to tears.

sentences.zh: 金人圍八日，登城縱火，子諲率官吏奪南楚門遁，城陷。

translations.literal: After the Jurchens besieged for eight days, they mounted the wall and set fires; Ziyin led officials and clerks to break through the South Chu Gate and flee, and the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jurchens besieged for eight days, they mounted the wall and set fires; Ziyin led officials and clerks to break through the South Chu Gate and flee, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 坐敵至失守落職罷。

translations.literal: He was punished with dismissal from office for failing to hold the city when the enemy arrived.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished with dismissal from office for failing to hold the city when the enemy arrived.

sentences.zh: 轉運副使賈收言子諲督兵巷戰，又收潰卒復入治事，帝亦以子諲與他守臣望風遁者殊科，詔復職。

translations.literal: Deputy transport commissioner Jia Shou reported that Ziyin had directed troops in street fighting and also gathered routed soldiers to return and conduct affairs; the emperor also considered that Ziyin was in a different category from other defending officials who fled at the first sign of danger, and ordered his office restored.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy transport commissioner Jia Shou reported that Ziyin had directed troops in street fighting and also gathered routed soldiers to return and conduct affairs; the emperor also considered that Ziyin was in a different category from other defending officials who fled at the first sign of danger, and ordered his office restored.

sentences.zh: 詔提舉江州太平觀。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him to administer the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him to administer the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 胡安國方避地湖南，以書抵秦檜，言：「子諲忠節，可以扶持三綱，願憐其無救而陷於賊，復加收用。」

translations.literal: Hu An'guo was then taking refuge in Hunan and wrote to Qin Hui, saying: "Ziyin is loyal and steadfast and can uphold the Three Bonds; I hope you will pity him for falling into the hands of bandits when there was no rescue, and restore and employ him again."
translations.idiomatic: Hu An'guo was then taking refuge in Hunan and wrote to Qin Hui, saying, "Ziyin is loyal and steadfast and can uphold the Three Bonds; I hope you will pity him for falling into the hands of bandits when there was no rescue, and restore and employ him again."

sentences.zh: 起知廣州。

translations.literal: He was recalled to serve as prefect of Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as prefect of Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 時恐賊度嶺，故就用子諲守之。

translations.literal: At the time they feared bandits would cross the mountains, and so Ziyin was immediately put in charge of the defense.
translations.idiomatic: At the time they feared bandits would cross the mountains, and so Ziyin was immediately put in charge of the defense.

sentences.zh: 又以言者罷，遂致仕。

translations.literal: Again because of remonstrators he was dismissed and then retired.
translations.idiomatic: Again because of remonstrators he was dismissed and then retired.

sentences.zh: 尋起知江州，改江東轉運使，進秘閣修撰。

translations.literal: Soon he was recalled as prefect of Jiangzhou, then changed to transport commissioner of Jiangdong, and promoted to Compiler of the Secret Archive.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled as prefect of Jiangzhou, then changed to transport commissioner of Jiangdong, and promoted to Compiler of the Secret Archive.

sentences.zh: 江東當餉劉光世軍，適劉豫入寇，光世軍合淝，以乏餉告，亟退師。

translations.literal: Jiangdong was to supply Liu Guangshi's army; just then Liu Yu invaded, Guangshi's army was at Hefei, and reporting lack of provisions he quickly withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangdong was to supply Liu Guangshi's army; just then Liu Yu invaded, Guangshi's army was at Hefei, and reporting lack of provisions he quickly withdrew.

sentences.zh: 子諲馳至合淝，具見糧以聞，光世由是得罪。

translations.literal: Ziyin galloped to Hefei, fully inspected the grain and reported; Guangshi was thereby found guilty.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin galloped to Hefei, fully inspected the grain and reported; Guangshi was thereby found guilty.

sentences.zh: 進徽猷閣待制。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall.

sentences.zh: 徙兩浙路為都轉運使，除戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Two-Zhe circuit as chief transport commissioner and appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Two-Zhe circuit as chief transport commissioner and appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 入見，論京都舊事，頗及珍玩。

translations.literal: On entering audience he discussed old affairs of the capital, touching considerably on rare treasures.
translations.idiomatic: On entering audience he discussed old affairs of the capital, touching considerably on rare treasures.

sentences.zh: 起居郎潘良貴故善子諲，聞其言甚怒。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Pan Lianggui had been friendly with Ziyin and was very angry on hearing his words.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Pan Lianggui had been friendly with Ziyin and was very angry on hearing his words.

sentences.zh: 既而子諲奏金國報聘及奠朱震事，反復良久。

translations.literal: Then Ziyin memorialized on the Jin state's return embassy and the offering for Zhu Zhen, going on at length.
translations.idiomatic: Then Ziyin memorialized on the Jin state's return embassy and the offering for Zhu Zhen, going on at length.

sentences.zh: 良貴徑至榻前厲聲叱之曰：「子諲不宜以無益之談，久煩聖聽。」

translations.literal: Lianggui went straight to the front of the couch and sternly rebuked him: "Ziyin should not weary the sacred ear with useless talk for so long."
translations.idiomatic: Lianggui went straight to the front of the couch and sternly rebuked him, "Ziyin should not weary the sacred ear with useless talk for so long."

sentences.zh: 子諲欲退，上謂良貴曰：「是朕問之也。」

translations.literal: Ziyin wished to withdraw; the emperor said to Lianggui: "It was I who asked him."
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin wished to withdraw; the emperor said to Lianggui, "It was I who asked him."

sentences.zh: 又諭子諲款語。

translations.literal: He again instructed Ziyin to speak at length.
translations.idiomatic: He again instructed Ziyin to speak at length.

sentences.zh: 子諲復語，久不止，良貴叱之退者再，上色變，欲抵良貴罪。

translations.literal: Ziyin spoke again and would not stop; Lianggui twice ordered him to withdraw; the emperor's expression changed and he wished to punish Lianggui.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin spoke again and would not stop; Lianggui twice ordered him to withdraw; the emperor's expression changed and he wished to punish Lianggui.

sentences.zh: 中丞常同言：「良貴無罪，願許子諲補外。」

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Chang Tong said: "Lianggui is not guilty; I hope Ziyin may be permitted to serve outside the capital."
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Chang Tong said, "Lianggui is not guilty; I hope Ziyin may be permitted to serve outside the capital."

sentences.zh: 上並怒同，張九成言：「士大夫所以嘉子諲者，以其能眷眷於善類。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry with Tong as well; Zhang Jiucheng said: "The reason scholars esteem Ziyin is that he cares deeply for good men.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry with Tong as well; Zhang Jiucheng said, "The reason scholars esteem Ziyin is that he cares deeply for good men.

sentences.zh: 今以子諲故逐柱史，又逐中司，非所以愛子諲也。」

translations.literal: Now because of Ziyin you dismiss the Censor and again dismiss the Central Secretariat censor—this is not the way to show affection for Ziyin."
translations.idiomatic: Now because of Ziyin you dismiss the Censor and again dismiss the Central Secretariat censor—this is not the way to show affection for Ziyin."

sentences.zh: 上意稍解，批諭同，同言不已，於是三人俱罷。

translations.literal: The emperor's mind was somewhat eased; he annotated and instructed Tong, but Tong would not stop speaking, and so all three were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's mind was somewhat eased; he annotated and instructed Tong, but Tong would not stop speaking, and so all three were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 子諲以徽猷閣直學士知平江府。

translations.literal: Ziyin served as Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall and prefect of Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin served as Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall and prefect of Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 金使議和將入境，子諲不肯拜金詔，乃上章言：「自古人主屈己和戎，未聞甚於此時，宜卻勿受。」

translations.literal: When Jin envoys came to discuss peace and were about to enter the border, Ziyin refused to bow to the Jin edict; he then submitted a memorial saying: "Since antiquity sovereigns have humbled themselves to make peace with barbarians, but never have I heard of anything worse than at this time—it should be refused and not accepted."
translations.idiomatic: When Jin envoys came to discuss peace and were about to enter the border, Ziyin refused to bow to the Jin edict; he then submitted a memorial saying, "Since antiquity sovereigns have humbled themselves to make peace with barbarians, but never have I heard of anything worse than at this time—it should be refused and not accepted."

sentences.zh: 忤秦檜意，乃致仕。

translations.literal: This offended Qin Hui's intent, and he retired.
translations.idiomatic: This offended Qin Hui's intent, and he retired.

sentences.zh: 子諲相家子，能修飭自見於時。

translations.literal: Ziyin was a son of a prime minister's family and was able to discipline himself and make himself seen in his time.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyin was a son of a prime minister's family and was able to discipline himself and make himself seen in his time.

sentences.zh: 友愛諸弟，置義莊，贍宗族貧者。

translations.literal: He was affectionate toward his younger brothers, established a charity estate, and supported poor clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: He was affectionate toward his younger brothers, established a charity estate, and supported poor clansmen.

sentences.zh: 初漕淮南時，張邦昌偽詔至，虹縣令已下迎拜宣讀如常式，獨武尉徐端益不拜而走。

translations.literal: When he first transported grain in Huainan, Zhang Bangchang's false edict arrived; the magistrate of Hong County and those below welcomed it, bowed, and proclaimed it as usual, but only Military Retainer Xu Duanyi refused to bow and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When he first transported grain in Huainan, Zhang Bangchang's false edict arrived; the magistrate of Hong County and those below welcomed it, bowed, and proclaimed it as usual, but only Military Retainer Xu Duanyi refused to bow and fled.

sentences.zh: 事定，子諲言于朝，易端益文資。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, Ziyin reported to the court and had Duanyi's civil rank changed.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was settled, Ziyin reported to the court and had Duanyi's civil rank changed.

sentences.zh: 退閑十五年，號所居曰「薌林」。

translations.literal: In retirement for fifteen years, he called his residence "Xianglin."
translations.idiomatic: In retirement for fifteen years, he called his residence "Xianglin."

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十八。

translations.literal: He died at age sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died at age sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 陳規，字元則，密州安丘人。

translations.literal: Chen Gui, styled Yuanze, was a native of Anqiu in Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Gui, styled Yuanze, was from Anqiu in Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 中明法科。

translations.literal: He passed the Mingfa examination.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the Mingfa examination.

sentences.zh: 靖康末，金人入侵，殺鎮海軍節度使劉延慶，其徒祝進、王在去為盜，犯隨、郢、復等州。

translations.literal: At the end of the Jingkang era the Jurchens invaded; they killed Military Commissioner of the Zhenhai Army Liu Yanqing, and his followers Zhu Jin and Wang Zai went off as bandits, raiding Sui, Ying, Fu, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Jingkang era the Jurchens invaded; they killed Military Commissioner of the Zhenhai Army Liu Yanqing, and his followers Zhu Jin and Wang Zai went off as bandits, raiding Sui, Ying, Fu, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 規為安陸令，以勤王兵赴汴，至蔡州，道梗而還。

translations.literal: Gui was magistrate of Anlu and led rescue-the-throne troops toward Bian; reaching Cai Prefecture, the roads were blocked and he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was magistrate of Anlu and led rescue-the-throne troops toward Bian; reaching Cai Prefecture, the roads were blocked and he returned.

sentences.zh: 會祝進攻德安府，守棄城遁，父老請規攝守事。

translations.literal: Just then Zhu Jin attacked De'an Prefecture; the prefect abandoned the city and fled, and the elders asked Gui to act as defender.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Zhu Jin attacked De'an Prefecture; the prefect abandoned the city and fled, and the elders asked Gui to act as defender.

sentences.zh: 規遣射士張立率兵討進，卻之。

translations.literal: Gui sent archer Zhang Li to lead troops against Jin and repulsed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gui sent archer Zhang Li to lead troops against Jin and repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 既而在復與進合，以砲石鵝車攻城東，規連戰敗之，二人懼，引眾去。

translations.literal: Later at Fu he joined with Jin; they used catapults and siege towers to attack the east gate. Gui repeatedly defeated them in battle, and the two men feared and withdrew with their forces.
translations.idiomatic: Later at Fu he joined with Jin; they used catapults and siege towers to attack the east gate. Gui repeatedly defeated them in battle, and the two men feared and withdrew with their forces.

sentences.zh: 時桑仲剽略襄、漢間，其副霍明屯兵郢上，規請於朝，就以明守郢。

translations.literal: At the time Sang Zhong plundered between Xiang and Han; his deputy Huo Ming stationed troops at Ying. Gui requested of the court that Ming be put in charge of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Sang Zhong plundered between Xiang and Han; his deputy Huo Ming stationed troops at Ying. Gui requested of the court that Ming be put in charge of Ying.

sentences.zh: 張浚都督行蜀道，仲引兵窺之，為王彥所敗。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun was grand coordinator on the Shu route; Zhong led troops to spy on him and was defeated by Wang Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun was grand coordinator on the Shu route; Zhong led troops to spy on him and was defeated by Wang Yan.

sentences.zh: 仲怒，從數百騎來譙明，明殺之，奔劉豫，以書招規，規械其使以聞。

translations.literal: Zhong was angry and came with several hundred horsemen to reproach Ming; Ming killed him, fled to Liu Yu, and sent a letter to recruit Gui; Gui shackled the messenger and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhong was angry and came with several hundred horsemen to reproach Ming; Ming killed him, fled to Liu Yu, and sent a letter to recruit Gui; Gui shackled the messenger and reported it.

sentences.zh: 李橫圍城，造天橋，填濠，鼓噪臨城。

translations.literal: Li Heng besieged the city, built sky-bridges, filled the moat, and with drums and shouts pressed the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng besieged the city, built sky-bridges, filled the moat, and with drums and shouts pressed the walls.

sentences.zh: 規帥軍民禦之，砲傷足，神色不變，圍急糧盡，出家財勞軍，士氣益振。

translations.literal: Gui led soldiers and civilians in defense; a catapult wounded his foot, but his expression did not change. The siege grew urgent and provisions were exhausted; he spent his family wealth to reward the army, and morale rose still more.
translations.idiomatic: Gui led soldiers and civilians in defense; a catapult wounded his foot, but his expression did not change. The siege grew urgent and provisions were exhausted; he spent his family wealth to reward the army, and morale rose still more.

sentences.zh: 橫遣人來，願得妓女罷軍，規不許。

translations.literal: Heng sent someone saying he wished to obtain a courtesan and would then withdraw the army; Gui would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Heng sent someone saying he wished to obtain a courtesan and would then withdraw the army; Gui would not agree.

sentences.zh: 諸將曰：「圍城七十日矣，以一婦活一城，不亦可乎。」

translations.literal: The generals said: "The city has been besieged seventy days; to save a whole city with one woman—would that not do?"
translations.idiomatic: The generals said, "The city has been besieged seventy days; to save a whole city with one woman—would that not do?"

sentences.zh: 規竟不予。

translations.literal: Gui ultimately would not give her.
translations.idiomatic: Gui ultimately would not give her.

sentences.zh: 會濠橋陷，規以六十人持火槍自西門出，焚天橋，以火牛助之，須臾皆盡，橫拔砦去。

translations.literal: When the moat bridge collapsed, Gui took sixty men with fire-lances out the west gate, burned the sky-bridge, and used fire-oxen to assist; in an instant all was destroyed, and Heng withdrew his camp.
translations.idiomatic: When the moat bridge collapsed, Gui took sixty men with fire-lances out the west gate, burned the sky-bridge, and used fire-oxen to assist; in an instant all was destroyed, and Heng withdrew his camp.

sentences.zh: 升徽猷閣直學士，詔赴行在，改顯謨閣直學士，徙知池州、沿江安撫使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall; an edict ordered him to the temporary capital; he was changed to Direct Academician of the Xianmo Hall and transferred as prefect of Chizhou and river pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall; an edict ordered him to the temporary capital; he was changed to Direct Academician of the Xianmo Hall and transferred as prefect of Chizhou and river pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 入對，首言：「鎮撫使當罷，諸將跋扈，請用偏裨以分其勢。」

translations.literal: On entering audience he first said: "Pacification commissioners should be abolished; the generals are overbearing—please use junior officers to divide their power."
translations.idiomatic: On entering audience he first said, "Pacification commissioners should be abolished; the generals are overbearing—please use junior officers to divide their power."

sentences.zh: 上皆納之。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted all of it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted all of it.

sentences.zh: 遷龍圖閣直學士，改知廬州，尋又召赴行在，以疾辭，提舉江州太平觀。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Direct Academician of the Longtu Hall and changed to prefect of Luzhou; soon he was again summoned to the temporary capital, but citing illness he declined and was appointed to administer the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Direct Academician of the Longtu Hall and changed to prefect of Luzhou; soon he was again summoned to the temporary capital, but citing illness he declined and was appointed to administer the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 復起知德安府，坐失察吏職，鐫兩官。

translations.literal: He was again recalled as prefect of De'an Prefecture; for failure to supervise officials he was reduced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: He was again recalled as prefect of De'an Prefecture; for failure to supervise officials he was reduced two ranks.

sentences.zh: 金人歸河南地，改知順昌府，葺城壁，招流亡，立保伍。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens returned Henan territory, he was changed to prefect of Shunchang Prefecture, repaired walls, recruited refugees, and established mutual-security groups.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens returned Henan territory, he was changed to prefect of Shunchang Prefecture, repaired walls, recruited refugees, and established mutual-security groups.

sentences.zh: 會劉錡領兵赴京留守過郡境，規出迎，坐未定，傳金人已入京城，即告錡城中有粟數萬斛，勉同為死守計。

translations.literal: When Liu Qi led troops passing through the prefecture on the way to the capital garrison, Gui went out to welcome him; before they had sat long, word came that the Jurchens had entered the capital. He immediately told Qi the city had tens of thousands of hu of grain and urged a joint plan for a death-defying defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Qi led troops passing through the prefecture on the way to the capital garrison, Gui went out to welcome him; before they had sat long, word came that the Jurchens had entered the capital. He immediately told Qi the city had tens of thousands of hu of grain and urged a joint plan for a death-defying defense.

sentences.zh: 相與登城區畫，分命諸將守四門，且明斥候，募土人鄉導間諜。

translations.literal: Together they mounted the wall to plan, assigned generals to guard the four gates, clarified scouts, and recruited local guides and spies.
translations.idiomatic: Together they mounted the wall to plan, assigned generals to guard the four gates, clarified scouts, and recruited local guides and spies.

sentences.zh: 佈設粗畢，金游騎已薄城矣。

translations.literal: When deployment was roughly complete, Jin scouting cavalry were already close to the city.
translations.idiomatic: When deployment was roughly complete, Jin scouting cavalry were already close to the city.

sentences.zh: 既至，金龍虎大王者提重兵踵至，規躬擐甲胄，與錡巡城督戰，用神臂弓射之，稍引退，復以步兵邀擊，溺於河者甚眾。

translations.literal: When they arrived, the Jin Prince of Gold and Tiger arrived with heavy troops in succession; Gui personally donned armor and, with Qi, patrolled the wall directing battle, shooting with the divine arm bow; they slightly withdrew, then infantry intercepted and many drowned in the river.
translations.idiomatic: When they arrived, the Jin Prince of Gold and Tiger arrived with heavy troops in succession; Gui personally donned armor and, with Qi, patrolled the wall directing battle, shooting with the divine arm bow; they slightly withdrew, then infantry intercepted and many drowned in the river.

sentences.zh: 規曰：「敵志屢挫，必思出奇困我，不若潛兵斫營，使彼晝夜不得休，可養吾銳也。」

translations.literal: Gui said: "The enemy's will has been repeatedly broken; they will surely think to use stratagems to trap us. Better to send troops secretly to cut their camp so they cannot rest day or night—this can preserve our sharpness."
translations.idiomatic: Gui said, "The enemy's will has been repeatedly broken; they will surely think to use stratagems to trap us. Better to send troops secretly to cut their camp so they cannot rest day or night—this can preserve our sharpness."

sentences.zh: 錡然之，果劫中其砦，殲其兵甚眾。

translations.literal: Qi agreed; they indeed raided the center of their camp and destroyed very many of their troops.
translations.idiomatic: Qi agreed; they indeed raided the center of their camp and destroyed very many of their troops.

sentences.zh: 金人告急於兀术。

translations.literal: The Jurchens urgently reported to Wuzhu.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens urgently reported to Wuzhu.

sentences.zh: 規大饗將士，酒半問曰：「兀术擁精兵且至，策將安出？」

translations.literal: Gui gave a great feast to the officers and soldiers; halfway through the wine he asked: "Wuzhu is coming with elite troops—what plan shall we adopt?"
translations.idiomatic: Gui gave a great feast to the officers and soldiers; halfway through the wine he asked, "Wuzhu is coming with elite troops—what plan shall we adopt?"

sentences.zh: 諸將或謂今已累捷，宜乘勢全師而歸。

translations.literal: Some generals said that having already won repeatedly, they should take advantage and withdraw the whole army.
translations.idiomatic: Some generals said that having already won repeatedly, they should take advantage and withdraw the whole army.

sentences.zh: 規曰：「朝廷養兵十五年，正欲為緩急用，況屢挫其鋒，軍聲稍振。

translations.literal: Gui said: "The court has maintained troops for fifteen years precisely for emergencies; moreover we have repeatedly broken their edge and military renown has somewhat revived.
translations.idiomatic: Gui said, "The court has maintained troops for fifteen years precisely for emergencies; moreover we have repeatedly broken their edge and military renown has somewhat revived.

sentences.zh: 規已分一死，進亦死，退亦死，不如進為忠也。」

translations.literal: I have already allotted myself to death—advance is death and retreat is death; better to advance in loyalty."
translations.idiomatic: I have already allotted myself to death—advance is death and retreat is death; better to advance in loyalty."

sentences.zh: 錡叱諸將曰：「府公文人猶誓死守，況汝曹耶！

translations.literal: Qi rebuked the generals: "The prefect is a civil official yet swears to die defending—how much more you!
translations.idiomatic: Qi rebuked the generals, "The prefect is a civil official yet swears to die defending—how much more you!

sentences.zh: 兼金營近三十里，兀术來援，我軍一動，金人追及，老幼先亂，必至狼狽，不獨廢前功，致兩淮侵擾，江、浙震驚。

translations.literal: Moreover the Jin camp is nearly thirty li away; when Wuzhu comes to aid, if our army moves the Jurchens will pursue, the old and young will first fall into disorder, and we will surely be thrown into confusion—not only wasting prior achievement and bringing the Two Huai into disturbance, but also shaking Jiang and Zhe.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Jin camp is nearly thirty li away; when Wuzhu comes to aid, if our army moves the Jurchens will pursue, the old and young will first fall into disorder, and we will surely be thrown into confusion—not only wasting prior achievement and bringing the Two Huai into disturbance, but also shaking Jiang and Zhe.

sentences.zh: 平生報君，反成誤國，不如背城一戰，死中求生可也。」

translations.literal: Repaying the sovereign in life yet becoming one who harms the state—better to fight with one's back to the wall and seek life within death."
translations.idiomatic: Repaying the sovereign in life yet becoming one who harms the state—better to fight with one's back to the wall and seek life within death."

sentences.zh: 已而兀术至，親循城，責諸酋用兵之失，眾跪曰：「南兵非昔比。」

translations.literal: Soon Wuzhu arrived, personally walked the wall, and rebuked the chiefs for military errors; the crowd knelt and said: "Southern troops are not as before."
translations.idiomatic: Soon Wuzhu arrived, personally walked the wall, and rebuked the chiefs for military errors; the crowd knelt and said, "Southern troops are not as before."

sentences.zh: 兀术下令晨飯府庭，且折箭為誓，並兵十餘萬攻城，自將鐵浮屠軍三千遊擊。

translations.literal: Wuzhu ordered breakfast in the prefectural courtyard, broke arrows in oath, combined more than a hundred thousand troops to attack the city, and personally led three thousand Iron Floating Tower troops in mobile attack.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhu ordered breakfast in the prefectural courtyard, broke arrows in oath, combined more than a hundred thousand troops to attack the city, and personally led three thousand Iron Floating Tower troops in mobile attack.

sentences.zh: 規與錡行城，勉激諸將，流矢及衣無懼色，軍殊死鬥。

translations.literal: Gui and Qi walked the wall, encouraged and roused the generals; stray arrows reached their clothes yet they showed no fear, and the army fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Gui and Qi walked the wall, encouraged and roused the generals; stray arrows reached their clothes yet they showed no fear, and the army fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 時方劇暑，規謂錡毋多出軍，第更隊易器，以逸制勞，蔑不勝矣。

translations.literal: It was then intense summer heat; Gui told Qi not to send out too many troops, but only to rotate units and change weapons, using rest to overcome fatigue—they would surely win.
translations.idiomatic: It was then intense summer heat; Gui told Qi not to send out too many troops, but only to rotate units and change weapons, using rest to overcome fatigue—they would surely win.

sentences.zh: 每清晨輒堅壁不出，伺金兵暴烈日中，至未申，氣力疲，則城中兵爭奮，斬獲無算，兀术宵遁。

translations.literal: Each morning he held the walls and did not go out, waiting until Jin troops were exposed in the blazing sun; by the hour of wei their strength was exhausted, then city troops competed in valor, killing and capturing beyond count, and Wuzhu fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Each morning he held the walls and did not go out, waiting until Jin troops were exposed in the blazing sun; by the hour of wei their strength was exhausted, then city troops competed in valor, killing and capturing beyond count, and Wuzhu fled by night.

sentences.zh: 錡奏功，詔褒諭之，遷樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Qi reported achievement; an edict praised and instructed him, and he was transferred to Direct Academician of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Qi reported achievement; an edict praised and instructed him, and he was transferred to Direct Academician of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 規至順昌，即廣糴粟麥實倉廩。

translations.literal: When Gui reached Shunchang, he immediately bought grain and wheat widely to fill the granaries.
translations.idiomatic: When Gui reached Shunchang, he immediately bought grain and wheat widely to fill the granaries.

sentences.zh: 會計議司移粟赴河上，規請以金帛代輸，至是得其用，成錡功者，食足故也。

translations.literal: The Accounting Bureau moved grain to the river; Gui requested substituting gold and silk for transport, and at this time it was put to use—what made Qi's achievement was having sufficient food.
translations.idiomatic: The Accounting Bureau moved grain to the river; Gui requested substituting gold and silk for transport, and at this time it was put to use—what made Qi's achievement was having sufficient food.

sentences.zh: 移知廬州兼淮西安撫，既至，疾作。

translations.literal: He was transferred as prefect of Luzhou and concurrently Huai'an pacification commissioner; once he arrived, illness set in.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred as prefect of Luzhou and concurrently Huai'an pacification commissioner; once he arrived, illness set in.

sentences.zh: 有旨修郡城，規在告，吏抱文書入臥內，規力疾起曰：「帥事，機宜董之；

translations.literal: There was an order to repair the prefectural walls; Gui was on sick leave, and clerks brought documents into his bedchamber; Gui forced himself up and said: "Command matters—the staff officer shall direct them;
translations.idiomatic: There was an order to repair the prefectural walls; Gui was on sick leave, and clerks brought documents into his bedchamber; Gui forced himself up and said, "Command matters—the staff officer shall direct them;

sentences.zh: 郡城，通判董之。」

translations.literal: the prefectural walls—the vice prefect shall direct them."
translations.idiomatic: the prefectural walls—the vice prefect shall direct them."

sentences.zh: 語畢而卒，年七十。

translations.literal: When he finished speaking he died, age seventy.
translations.idiomatic: When he finished speaking he died, age seventy.

sentences.zh: 贈右正議大夫。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given Right Regular Policy Grandee.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously given Right Regular Policy Grandee.

sentences.zh: 有《攻守方略》傳於世。

translations.literal: He had Attack-and-Defense Strategy transmitted in the world.
translations.idiomatic: His Attack-and-Defense Strategy was transmitted in the world.

sentences.zh: 初，規守德安時，嘗條上營屯田事宜，欲仿古屯田之制，合射士民兵，分地耕墾。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Gui defended De'an, he once submitted in detail matters of garrison-colony fields, wishing to follow the ancient garrison-colony system, combining archers, militia, and soldiers to divide land for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Gui defended De'an, he once submitted in detail matters of garrison-colony fields, wishing to follow the ancient garrison-colony system, combining archers, militia, and soldiers to divide land for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 軍士所屯之田，皆相險隘立堡砦，寇至則堡聚捍禦，無事則乘時田作，射士皆分半以耕屯田。

translations.literal: Fields garrisoned by soldiers all established fortresses at strategic passes; when bandits came the forts gathered to defend, when there was peace they farmed in season, and archers all divided half their time to farm colony fields.
translations.idiomatic: Fields garrisoned by soldiers all established fortresses at strategic passes; when bandits came the forts gathered to defend, when there was peace they farmed in season, and archers all divided half their time to farm colony fields.

sentences.zh: 民戶所營之田，水田畝賦粳米一斗，陸田賦麥豆各五升。

translations.literal: For fields operated by civilian households, paddy fields paid one dou of polished rice per mu, dry fields paid five sheng each of wheat and beans.
translations.idiomatic: For fields operated by civilian households, paddy fields paid one dou of polished rice per mu, dry fields paid five sheng each of wheat and beans.

sentences.zh: 滿三年無逋輸，給為永業。

translations.literal: After three full years without arrears, the land was granted as permanent property.
translations.idiomatic: After three full years without arrears, the land was granted as permanent property.

sentences.zh: 流民自歸者以田還之。

translations.literal: Refugees who returned of themselves had fields returned to them.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees who returned of themselves had fields returned to them.

sentences.zh: 凡屯田事，營田司兼行，營田事，府縣官兼行，皆不更置官吏，條列以聞，詔嘉獎之，仍下其法于諸鎮。

translations.literal: All colony-field matters were jointly handled by the Colony Field Bureau; colony-field affairs were jointly handled by prefectural and county officials, without adding new officials; he listed items and reported, and an edict praised and rewarded him and still sent his method down to the various garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: All colony-field matters were jointly handled by the Colony Field Bureau; colony-field affairs were jointly handled by prefectural and county officials, without adding new officials; he listed items and reported, and an edict praised and rewarded him and still sent his method down to the various garrisons.

sentences.zh: 自紹興以來，文臣鎮撫使有威聲者，惟規而已。

translations.literal: Since the Shaoxing era, among civil pacification commissioners with martial renown, only Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Shaoxing era, among civil pacification commissioners with martial renown, only Gui.

sentences.zh: 規端毅寡言笑，然待人和易。

translations.literal: Gui was dignified and resolute, sparing of words and laughter, yet treated people with ease.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was dignified and resolute, sparing of words and laughter, yet treated people with ease.

sentences.zh: 以忠義自許，尤好振施，家無贏財。

translations.literal: He pledged himself to loyalty and righteousness and especially loved generous giving; his household had no surplus wealth.
translations.idiomatic: He pledged himself to loyalty and righteousness and especially loved generous giving; his household had no surplus wealth.

sentences.zh: 嘗為女求從婢，得一婦甚閒雅，怪而詢之，乃雲夢張貢士女也，亂離夫死無所託，鬻身求活，規即輟女奩嫁之，聞者感泣。

translations.literal: Once seeking a maid for his daughter, he obtained a woman very refined and elegant; wondering, he questioned her—it was the daughter of a Yunmeng jinshi; her husband died in the chaos and she had nowhere to rely on, and sold herself to live. Gui immediately gave his daughter's dowry to marry her; hearers were moved to tears.
translations.idiomatic: Once seeking a maid for his daughter, he obtained a woman very refined and elegant; wondering, he questioned her—it was the daughter of a Yunmeng jinshi; her husband died in the chaos and she had nowhere to rely on, and sold herself to live. Gui immediately gave his daughter's dowry to marry her; hearers were moved to tears.

sentences.zh: 規功名與諸將等，而位不酬勞，時共惜之。

translations.literal: Gui's merit was equal to the generals, yet his rank did not match his labor; contemporaries together regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: Gui's merit was equal to the generals, yet his rank did not match his labor; contemporaries together regretted it.

sentences.zh: 乾道八年，詔刻《規德安守城錄》頒天下為諸守將法。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qiandao, an edict ordered the Record of Chen Gui's Defense of De'an carved and distributed throughout the realm as a model for defending generals.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Qiandao, an edict ordered the Record of Chen Gui's Defense of De'an carved and distributed throughout the realm as a model for defending generals.

sentences.zh: 立廟德安，賜額「賢守」，追封忠利侯，後加封智敏。

translations.literal: A temple was established at De'an, granted the title "Worthy Defender," posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Loyal Benefit, later additionally enfeoffed as Wise and Keen.
translations.idiomatic: A temple was established at De'an, granted the title "Worthy Defender," posthumously enfeoffed as Marquis of Loyal Benefit, later additionally enfeoffed as Wise and Keen.

sentences.zh: 季陵，字延仲，處之龍泉人。

translations.literal: Ji Ling, styled Yanzhong, was a native of Longquan in Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Ling, styled Yanzhong, was from Longquan in Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 登政和二年上舍第，三遷太學博士。

translations.literal: He passed the upper-house examination in the second year of Zhenghe and after three promotions became Erudite of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the upper-house examination in the second year of Zhenghe and after three promotions became Erudite of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 論學術邪正異同，長官怒，譖之執政，謫知舒城縣。

translations.literal: Discussing whether learning was orthodox or heterodox and their similarities and differences, the chief official was angry, slandered him to the chief ministers, and he was demoted as prefect of Shucheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Discussing whether learning was orthodox or heterodox and their similarities and differences, the chief official was angry, slandered him to the chief ministers, and he was demoted as prefect of Shucheng County.

sentences.zh: 未幾，除太常寺簿，遷比部員外郎。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Registrar of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and transferred to Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Registrar of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and transferred to Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，從至揚州。

translations.literal: When Gaozong took the throne, he followed to Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong took the throne, he followed to Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 建炎二年，守尚書右司員外郎、太常少卿。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianyan he held Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jianyan he held Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 金人南侵，帝幸杭州，朝廷儀物皆委棄之，陵奉九廟神主負之以行，拜起居郎，遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens invaded south, the emperor went to Hangzhou; court ritual objects were all abandoned; Ling carried the spirit tablets of the Nine Temples on his back as he went, was appointed Attendant Gentleman, and transferred to Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens invaded south, the emperor went to Hangzhou; court ritual objects were all abandoned; Ling carried the spirit tablets of the Nine Temples on his back as he went, was appointed Attendant Gentleman, and transferred to Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三年六月，淫雨，詔求直言。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the third year there was excessive rain; an edict sought forthright speech.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year there was excessive rain; an edict sought forthright speech.

sentences.zh: 陵言：

translations.literal: Ling said:
translations.idiomatic: Ling said:

sentences.zh: 「金人累歲侵軼，生靈塗炭，怨氣所積，災異之來，固不足怪。

translations.literal: "The Jurchens for years have raided and trampled; the people are smeared with charcoal; resentment accumulates—disasters and anomalies coming is certainly not strange.
translations.idiomatic: "The Jurchens for years have raided and trampled; the people are smeared with charcoal; resentment accumulates—disasters and anomalies coming is certainly not strange.

sentences.zh: 『惟先格王，正厥事』，則在我者其可忽邪？

translations.literal: 'Only first correct the king and rectify his affairs'—can what lies with us be neglected?
translations.idiomatic: 'Only first correct the king and rectify his affairs'—can what lies with us be neglected?

sentences.zh: 臣觀廟堂無擅命之臣，惟將帥之權太盛；

translations.literal: I observe the court hall has no ministers who usurp orders, but only the power of generals is too great;
translations.idiomatic: I observe the court hall has no ministers who usurp orders, but only the power of generals is too great;

sentences.zh: 宮閫無女謁之私，惟宦寺之習未革。

translations.literal: the inner palace has no private access for women, but only eunuch customs are not reformed.
translations.idiomatic: the inner palace has no private access for women, but only eunuch customs are not reformed.

sentences.zh: 今將帥擁兵自衛，浸成跋扈，苗、劉竊發，勤王之師一至，淩轢官吏，莫敢誰何？

translations.literal: Now generals hold troops to protect themselves, gradually becoming overbearing; when Miao and Liu stole the initiative and rescue-the-throne armies arrived, they trampled officials—who dared reproach them?
translations.idiomatic: Now generals hold troops to protect themselves, gradually becoming overbearing; when Miao and Liu stole the initiative and rescue-the-throne armies arrived, they trampled officials—who dared reproach them?

sentences.zh: 此將帥之權太盛，有以干陽也。

translations.literal: This is generals' power too great, which has offended yang.
translations.idiomatic: This is generals' power too great, which has offended yang.

sentences.zh: 宦寺縱橫，上下共憤，卒碎賊手，可為戒矣。

translations.literal: Eunuchs ran rampant; above and below shared anger; in the end they were crushed by bandits' hands—this can serve as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs ran rampant; above and below shared anger; in the end they were crushed by bandits' hands—this can serve as a warning.

sentences.zh: 比聞復召藍珪，黨與相賀，聞者切齒，此宦寺之習未革有以干陽也。

translations.literal: Recently I heard Lan Gui was again summoned; his faction congratulated one another; hearers gnashed teeth—this is eunuch custom not reformed, which has offended yang.
translations.idiomatic: Recently I heard Lan Gui was again summoned; his faction congratulated one another; hearers gnashed teeth—this is eunuch custom not reformed, which has offended yang.

sentences.zh: 《洪範》：『休徵曰肅，時雨若……謀，時寒若；

translations.literal: The Hong Fan: 'A favorable sign is reverence, then timely rain... counsel, then timely cold;
translations.idiomatic: The Hong Fan: 'A favorable sign is reverence, then timely rain... counsel, then timely cold;

sentences.zh: 咎徵曰狂，恒雨若……急，恒寒若。』

translations.literal: an unfavorable sign is madness, then constant rain... haste, then constant cold.'
translations.idiomatic: an unfavorable sign is madness, then constant rain... haste, then constant cold.'

sentences.zh: 自古天子之出，必載廟主行，示有尊也。

translations.literal: Since antiquity when the Son of Heaven went out he necessarily carried the temple tablets, showing there was reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity when the Son of Heaven went out he necessarily carried the temple tablets, showing there was reverence.

sentences.zh: 前日倉卒迎奉，不能如禮。

translations.literal: The other day in haste welcoming and escorting, it could not be as ritual required.
translations.idiomatic: The other day in haste welcoming and escorting, it could not be as ritual required.

sentences.zh: 既至錢塘，置太廟于道宮，薦享有闕；

translations.literal: Having reached Qiantang, the Grand Temple was placed in a Daoist abbey and offerings were deficient;
translations.idiomatic: Having reached Qiantang, the Grand Temple was placed in a Daoist abbey and offerings were deficient;

sentences.zh: 留神御于河滸，安奉後時。

translations.literal: the imperial spirit was left at the river bank and installation came late.
translations.idiomatic: the imperial spirit was left at the river bank and installation came late.

sentences.zh: 不肅之咎，臣意宗廟當之。

translations.literal: The fault of irreverence—in my view the ancestral temple should bear it.
translations.idiomatic: The fault of irreverence—in my view the ancestral temple should bear it.

sentences.zh: 比年盜賊例許招安，未幾再叛，反墮其計。

translations.literal: In recent years bandits were routinely permitted to accept amnesty; before long they rebelled again, falling into their scheme.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years bandits were routinely permitted to accept amnesty; before long they rebelled again, falling into their scheme.

sentences.zh: 忠臣之憤不雪，赤子之冤莫報，不謀之咎，臣意盜賊當之。

translations.literal: Loyal ministers' anger is not cleared; common people's wrongs are not avenged—the fault of lack of counsel, in my view bandits should bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Loyal ministers' anger is not cleared; common people's wrongs are not avenged—the fault of lack of counsel, in my view bandits should bear it.

sentences.zh: 道路之言謂鑾輿不久居此，自臣臆度，決無是事，假或有之，不幾於狂乎？

translations.literal: Roadside talk says the imperial carriage will not long remain here; by my own reckoning there is absolutely no such thing—if there were, would it not be close to madness?
translations.idiomatic: Roadside talk says the imperial carriage will not long remain here; by my own reckoning there is absolutely no such thing—if there were, would it not be close to madness?

sentences.zh: 軍興以來，既結保甲，又改巡社，既招弓手，又募民兵，民力竭矣，而猶誅求焉，不幾於急乎？

translations.literal: Since military campaigns began, mutual-security groups were already formed, patrol communities were also changed, bowmen were recruited and militia also levied—the people's strength is exhausted, yet exactions continue—would that not be close to haste?
translations.idiomatic: Since military campaigns began, mutual-security groups were already formed, patrol communities were also changed, bowmen were recruited and militia also levied—the people's strength is exhausted, yet exactions continue—would that not be close to haste?

sentences.zh: 此皆陰道太盛所致。」

translations.literal: All these are caused by yin being too strong."
translations.idiomatic: All these are caused by yin being too strong."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 時除梁揚祖為發運使，給事中劉寧止言其不可，乃以起居郎綦崇禮權給事中，書讀，陵封還錄黃。

translations.literal: At the time Liang Yangzu was appointed transport commissioner; Giving Attendant Liu Ningzhi said it was not suitable; then Attendant Gentleman Qi Chongli was made acting Giving Attendant; when the draft was read, Ling sealed and returned the recorded yellow.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Liang Yangzu was appointed transport commissioner; Giving Attendant Liu Ningzhi said it was not suitable; then Attendant Gentleman Qi Chongli was made acting Giving Attendant; when the draft was read, Ling sealed and returned the recorded yellow.

sentences.zh: 又言：「防秋已迫，願陛下先定兵衛及扈從之臣，萬一敵勢猖獗，便當整駕親按營壘，召諸道兵以為援，留將相大臣，相率死守，勿效前日百官跣足奔竄，以扈蹕為名，棄城池以予敵，使生靈墮塗炭，財用填溝壑。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Autumn defense is already urgent; I hope Your Majesty will first fix military guards and escort ministers—if the enemy's force should run wild, then you should marshal the carriage personally to inspect camps, summon troops from all routes as aid, leave chief ministers and great ministers to lead one another in death-defying defense, and not imitate the other day when officials fled barefoot in panic in the name of escorting the carriage, abandoning cities to give the enemy, making the people fall into charcoal and wealth fill gullies and ditches."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Autumn defense is already urgent; I hope Your Majesty will first fix military guards and escort ministers—if the enemy's force should run wild, then you should marshal the carriage personally to inspect camps, summon troops from all routes as aid, leave chief ministers and great ministers to lead one another in death-defying defense, and not imitate the other day when officials fled barefoot in panic in the name of escorting the carriage, abandoning cities to give the enemy, making the people fall into charcoal and wealth fill gullies and ditches."

sentences.zh: 時張浚為川陝等路宣撫處置使，陵論其太專，忤旨，罷為徽猷閣待制、知太平州，未行，落職與祠。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Jun was grand coordinator and disposition commissioner of the Chuan-Shaanxi routes; Ling criticized him as too autocratic, offended the imperial intent, was dismissed as Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall and prefect of Taiping Prefecture; before going he was stripped of office and given a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Jun was grand coordinator and disposition commissioner of the Chuan-Shaanxi routes; Ling criticized him as too autocratic, offended the imperial intent, was dismissed as Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall and prefect of Taiping Prefecture; before going he was stripped of office and given a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 數月，復職，除知溫州，又改中書舍人，皆力辭。

translations.literal: After several months his office was restored; he was appointed prefect of Wenzhou, then changed to Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat—all he forcefully declined.
translations.idiomatic: After several months his office was restored; he was appointed prefect of Wenzhou, then changed to Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat—all he forcefully declined.

sentences.zh: 范宗尹薦其才，命知臨安府，復為中書舍人。

translations.literal: Fan Zongyin recommended his talent; he was ordered prefect of Lin'an Prefecture and again Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zongyin recommended his talent; he was ordered prefect of Lin'an Prefecture and again Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 入對，言：

translations.literal: On entering audience he said:
translations.idiomatic: On entering audience he said:

sentences.zh: 「事有可深慮者四，尚可恃者一：大駕未有駐蹕之地、賢人皆無經世之心、兵柄分而將不和、政權去而主益弱；

translations.literal: "There are four matters that can be deeply considered, and one that can still be relied on: the great carriage has no place of permanent halt, worthy men all lack minds to order the age, military power is divided and generals are not harmonious, government power departs and the ruler grows weaker;
translations.idiomatic: "There are four matters that can be deeply considered, and one that can still be relied on: the great carriage has no place of permanent halt, worthy men all lack minds to order the age, military power is divided and generals are not harmonious, government power departs and the ruler grows weaker;

sentences.zh: 所恃以僅存者，人心未厭而已。

translations.literal: what can be relied on for bare survival is only that hearts of the people are not yet weary.
translations.idiomatic: what can be relied on for bare survival is only that hearts of the people are not yet weary.

sentences.zh: 前年議渡江，人以為可，朝廷以為不可，故諱言南渡而降詔回鑾。

translations.literal: The year before last they debated crossing the Yangzi—people thought it feasible, the court thought it not, so they avoided speaking of southward crossing and issued an edict to return the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: The year before last they debated crossing the Yangzi—people thought it feasible, the court thought it not, so they avoided speaking of southward crossing and issued an edict to return the carriage.

sentences.zh: 去年議幸蜀，人以為不可，朝廷以為可，故弛備江、淮，經營關、陝。

translations.literal: Last year they debated going to Shu—people thought it not feasible, the court thought it feasible, so they relaxed defense of Jiang and Huai and managed Guan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Last year they debated going to Shu—people thought it not feasible, the court thought it feasible, so they relaxed defense of Jiang and Huai and managed Guan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 以今觀之，孰得孰失？

translations.literal: Viewing today, which is gain and which is loss?
translations.idiomatic: Viewing today, which is gain and which is loss?

sentences.zh: 維揚之變，朝廷不及知而功歸宦寺；

translations.literal: At the Weiyang change the court did not know in time yet merit went to eunuchs;
translations.idiomatic: At the Weiyang change the court did not know in time yet merit went to eunuchs;

sentences.zh: 錢塘之變，朝廷不能救而功歸將帥，是致此曹有輕朝士之心。

translations.literal: at the Qiantang change the court could not rescue yet merit went to generals—this makes these men have hearts that slight court scholars.
translations.idiomatic: at the Qiantang change the court could not rescue yet merit went to generals—this makes these men have hearts that slight court scholars.

sentences.zh: 黃潛善好自用不能用人，呂頤浩知使能不知任賢。

translations.literal: Huang Qianshan liked to use his own judgment and could not employ men; Lü Yihao knew how to use ability but did not know how to appoint the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Qianshan liked to use his own judgment and could not employ men; Lü Yihao knew how to use ability but did not know how to appoint the worthy.

sentences.zh: 自張愨、許景衡飲恨而死，凡知幾自重者，往往卷懷退縮。

translations.literal: Since Zhang Kai and Xu Jingheng died with resentment, all who knew restraint and valued themselves often rolled up their hearts and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Since Zhang Kai and Xu Jingheng died with resentment, all who knew restraint and valued themselves often rolled up their hearts and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 今天下不可謂無兵，劉光世、韓世忠、張俊各招亡命以張軍勢，各效小勞以報主恩。

translations.literal: Today one cannot say there are no troops—Liu Guangshi, Han Shizhong, and Zhang Jun each recruited fugitives to expand military force and each rendered small service to repay sovereign grace.
translations.idiomatic: Today one cannot say there are no troops—Liu Guangshi, Han Shizhong, and Zhang Jun each recruited fugitives to expand military force and each rendered small service to repay sovereign grace.

sentences.zh: 然勝不相遜，敗不相救，大敵一至，人自為謀耳。

translations.literal: Yet in victory they did not yield to one another, in defeat they did not rescue one another—when a great enemy came, each man schemed for himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in victory they did not yield to one another, in defeat they did not rescue one another—when a great enemy came, each man schemed for himself.

sentences.zh: 周望在浙西，人能言之；

translations.literal: Zhou Wang in western Zhe—people can speak of it;
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Wang in western Zhe—people can speak of it;

sentences.zh: 張浚在陝右，無敢言者。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun in western Shaanxi—none dare speak.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun in western Shaanxi—none dare speak.

sentences.zh: 夫軍事恐失機會，便宜可也，乃若自降詔書，得無竊命之嫌邪？

translations.literal: In military affairs one fears losing opportunity—expediency is permissible; yet to issue edicts oneself—is there not suspicion of usurping orders?
translations.idiomatic: In military affairs one fears losing opportunity—expediency is permissible; yet to issue edicts oneself—is there not suspicion of usurping orders?

sentences.zh: 官吏責以辦事，便宜可也，乃若安置從臣，得無忌器之嫌邪？

translations.literal: Officials are charged to handle affairs—expediency is permissible; yet to place followers—is there not suspicion of coveting power?
translations.idiomatic: Officials are charged to handle affairs—expediency is permissible; yet to place followers—is there not suspicion of coveting power?

sentences.zh: 以至賜姓氏，改寺額，此皆傷於太專，臣恐自陝以西不知有陛下矣。

translations.literal: Even to granting surnames and changing temple names—all these harm by being too autocratic; I fear west of Shaanxi they no longer know there is Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Even to granting surnames and changing temple names—all these harm by being too autocratic; I fear west of Shaanxi they no longer know there is Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 惟祖宗德澤在人心未忘，所望以中興者此耳，陛下宜有以結之。

translations.literal: Only the ancestors' virtue and grace remain in hearts not forgotten—what is hoped for in restoration is this; Your Majesty should have means to bind them.
translations.idiomatic: Only the ancestors' virtue and grace remain in hearts not forgotten—what is hoped for in restoration is this; Your Majesty should have means to bind them.

sentences.zh: 今欲薄斂以裕民財，而用度方闕；

translations.literal: Now you wish light levies to enrich the people's wealth, yet expenditures are just lacking;
translations.idiomatic: Now you wish light levies to enrich the people's wealth, yet expenditures are just lacking;

sentences.zh: 輕徭以紓民力，而師旅方興。

translations.literal: light corvée to ease the people's strength, yet armies and brigades are just rising.
translations.idiomatic: light corvée to ease the people's strength, yet armies and brigades are just rising.

sentences.zh: 罪己之詔屢降，憂民之言屢聞，丁寧切至，終莫之信。

translations.literal: Edicts of self-reproach repeatedly descend, words of concern for the people repeatedly heard—earnest and urgent to the utmost—yet in the end none believe.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts of self-reproach repeatedly descend, words of concern for the people repeatedly heard—earnest and urgent to the utmost—yet in the end none believe.

sentences.zh: 臣謂動民以行不以言，陛下爵當賢，祿當功，刑當罪，施設注措無不當理，天下不心服者未之有也。」

translations.literal: I say move the people by action not words—Your Majesty's enfeoffments should match the worthy, salaries should match merit, punishments should match guilt; in all arrangements nothing should fail reason—there has never been one under Heaven whose heart is not satisfied."
translations.idiomatic: I say move the people by action not words—Your Majesty's enfeoffments should match the worthy, salaries should match merit, punishments should match guilt; in all arrangements nothing should fail reason—there has never been one under Heaven whose heart is not satisfied."

sentences.zh: 朱勝非除江西帥，未行，陵言：「金人往年休士馬于燕山，次年移河北，又次年移京東，今寓淮甸，無復去意，患在朝夕，可謂急矣。

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei was appointed Jiangxi commander; before going Ling said: "In former years the Jurchens rested troops and horses at Yan Mountain, the next year moved to Hebei, the year after moved to Jingdong; now they lodge in the Huai region with no further intent to leave—the danger is imminent, one can say it is urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei was appointed Jiangxi commander; before going Ling said, "In former years the Jurchens rested troops and horses at Yan Mountain, the next year moved to Hebei, the year after moved to Jingdong; now they lodge in the Huai region with no further intent to leave—the danger is imminent, one can say it is urgent.

sentences.zh: 若頤浩既去，勝非未至，金人南向，兵不素練，糧不素積，又不設險，何以禦之？

translations.literal: If Yihao has already gone and Shengfei has not arrived, and the Jurchens go south—troops are not trained by habit, grain is not stored by habit, and no defenses are set—how can they be resisted?
translations.idiomatic: If Yihao has already gone and Shengfei has not arrived, and the Jurchens go south—troops are not trained by habit, grain is not stored by habit, and no defenses are set—how can they be resisted?

sentences.zh: 臣願陛下更擇賢副，預為經畫以待。

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will further choose worthy deputies and plan in advance to await it.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will further choose worthy deputies and plan in advance to await it.

sentences.zh: 今日非論安危，實論存亡，朝謀夕行，當如拯溺，豈可不惜分陰。」

translations.literal: Today it is not discussing safety and danger but discussing survival and extinction—plan in the morning and act in the evening, it should be like saving the drowning; how can one not cherish every moment?"
translations.idiomatic: Today it is not discussing safety and danger but discussing survival and extinction—plan in the morning and act in the evening, it should be like saving the drowning; how can one not cherish every moment?"

sentences.zh: 詔劉洪道趣往池州，措置防江。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Liu Hongdao to hurry to Chizhou to arrange river defense.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Liu Hongdao to hurry to Chizhou to arrange river defense.

sentences.zh: 除戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 范宗尹嘗仕偽楚，故凡受偽命者皆錄用。

translations.literal: Fan Zongyin had once served the false Chu, and so all who received false appointments were recorded and employed.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zongyin had once served the false Chu, and so all who received false appointments were recorded and employed.

sentences.zh: 陵因上疏曰：「前日士大夫名節不立，論事者皆喜攻之，瑕疵既彰，不復可用，縱加抆拭，攻者踵來，雖君相制命，亦不能為之地。

translations.literal: Ling therefore submitted a memorial saying: "In former days scholars did not establish moral repute; those who discussed affairs all liked to attack; once flaws were exposed they could not again be used—even if wiped clean, attackers followed; though ruler and minister ordered, they could not make room for them.
translations.idiomatic: Ling therefore submitted a memorial saying, "In former days scholars did not establish moral repute; those who discussed affairs all liked to attack; once flaws were exposed they could not again be used—even if wiped clean, attackers followed; though ruler and minister ordered, they could not make room for them.

sentences.zh: 臣試舉其罪大者言之，崇寧、大觀以來，黨助巨姦，由詭道以饕寵榮者不知幾何人？

translations.literal: I try to speak of those whose crimes are greatest: since Chongning and Daguan, party factions aiding great villains—those who by crooked paths glutted themselves on favor and glory, who knows how many men?
translations.idiomatic: I try to speak of those whose crimes are greatest: since Chongning and Daguan, party factions aiding great villains—those who by crooked paths glutted themselves on favor and glory, who knows how many men?

sentences.zh: 邦昌亂朝，不能死節者不知幾何人？

translations.literal: When Bangchang disturbed the court, those who could not die in integrity—who knows how many men?
translations.idiomatic: When Bangchang disturbed the court, those who could not die in integrity—who knows how many men?

sentences.zh: 苗、劉專殺，拱手受制不知幾何人？

translations.literal: When Miao and Liu monopolized killing, those who folded hands and were controlled—who knows how many men?
translations.idiomatic: When Miao and Liu monopolized killing, those who folded hands and were controlled—who knows how many men?

sentences.zh: 以義責之固不容誅，以情恕之亦不幸耳。

translations.literal: To charge them by righteousness certainly does not permit execution; to pardon them by feeling is also unfortunate.
translations.idiomatic: To charge them by righteousness certainly does not permit execution; to pardon them by feeling is also unfortunate.

sentences.zh: 弄筆墨者，文致其罪，既得惡名，誰敢引薦。

translations.literal: Those who wield brush and ink craft their crimes; once they have an evil name, who dares recommend them?
translations.idiomatic: Those who wield brush and ink craft their crimes; once they have an evil name, who dares recommend them?

sentences.zh: 臣願明詔宰執，於罪戾中選擇實能，量付以事，勿因一眚廢其終身，仍詔臺諫為國愛人，勿復言。」

translations.literal: I hope for a clear edict to the chief ministers: from among the guilty choose real ability, assign affairs according to measure, do not because of one fault discard them for life; still order censors to love the state and men and speak no more."
translations.idiomatic: I hope for a clear edict to the chief ministers: from among the guilty choose real ability, assign affairs according to measure, do not because of one fault discard them for life; still order censors to love the state and men and speak no more."

sentences.zh: 詔榜其疏於朝堂。

translations.literal: An edict posted his memorial in the court hall.
translations.idiomatic: An edict posted his memorial in the court hall.

sentences.zh: 侍御史沈與求劾陵承望宰執風旨，罷官，提舉杭州洞霄宮。

translations.literal: Attendant Censor Shen Yuqiu impeached Ling for currying favor with the chief ministers' intent; he was dismissed and appointed to administer the Dongxiao Abbey in Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Censor Shen Yuqiu impeached Ling for currying favor with the chief ministers' intent; he was dismissed and appointed to administer the Dongxiao Abbey in Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，復右文殿修撰。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing he was restored as Compiler of the Youwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing he was restored as Compiler of the Youwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 二年，詔內外官言事。

translations.literal: In the second year an edict ordered inner and outer officials to speak on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year an edict ordered inner and outer officials to speak on affairs.

sentences.zh: 陵言：

translations.literal: Ling said:
translations.idiomatic: Ling said:

sentences.zh: 「軍興以來，朝廷誥牒，非強以予民則莫售；

translations.literal: "Since military campaigns began, court proclamations—unless forcibly given to the people they would not sell;
translations.idiomatic: "Since military campaigns began, court proclamations—unless forcibly given to the people they would not sell;

sentences.zh: 師旅糧草，非強取于民則莫給。

translations.literal: army provisions and fodder—unless forcibly taken from the people they would not be supplied.
translations.idiomatic: army provisions and fodder—unless forcibly taken from the people they would not be supplied.

sentences.zh: 舊例和買，無本可支者久矣，新行和糴，能償其直幾何？

translations.literal: The old practice of harmonized purchase—those without capital to pay has long been so; the newly implemented harmonized requisition—how much can repay its price?
translations.idiomatic: The old practice of harmonized purchase—those without capital to pay has long been so; the newly implemented harmonized requisition—how much can repay its price?

sentences.zh: 一遇軍興，事事責辦，有不足者，預借後年之賦。

translations.literal: Once military campaigns arise, every matter is charged for fulfillment; where there is insufficiency, they advance-borrow next year's levies.
translations.idiomatic: Once military campaigns arise, every matter is charged for fulfillment; where there is insufficiency, they advance-borrow next year's levies.

sentences.zh: 雖名曰『和』，實彊取之；

translations.literal: Though called 'harmonized,' in fact it is forcibly taken;
translations.idiomatic: Though called 'harmonized,' in fact it is forcibly taken;

sentences.zh: 雖名曰『借』，其實奪之。

translations.literal: though called 'borrow,' in fact it is seized.
translations.idiomatic: though called 'borrow,' in fact it is seized.

sentences.zh: 兵將衣食不取其飽煖，取其豐美；

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers for food and clothing do not take what is filling and warm but take what is rich and fine;
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers for food and clothing do not take what is filling and warm but take what is rich and fine;

sentences.zh: 器械不取其堅利，取其華好。

translations.literal: for weapons and equipment they do not take what is solid and sharp but take what is ornate and handsome.
translations.idiomatic: for weapons and equipment they do not take what is solid and sharp but take what is ornate and handsome.

sentences.zh: 務末勝本，初無鬥心，賊至則偽言退保，賊去則盛言收復，遇敗以千為一，遇勝以一為千。

translations.literal: They value the branch over the root and from the first have no fighting spirit; when bandits come they falsely say they withdraw to defend, when bandits leave they loudly say they recover—in defeat they count a thousand as one, in victory they count one as a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: They value the branch over the root and from the first have no fighting spirit; when bandits come they falsely say they withdraw to defend, when bandits leave they loudly say they recover—in defeat they count a thousand as one, in victory they count one as a thousand.

sentences.zh: 今乘輿服御之費十去七八，百官有司之費十去五六，猶無益于國者，軍太冗也。

translations.literal: Now the imperial carriage's clothing and use costs seven or eight tenths gone, officials' and clerks' costs five or six tenths gone—yet what does not benefit the state is that the army is too redundant.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial carriage's clothing and use costs seven or eight tenths gone, officials' and clerks' costs five or six tenths gone—yet what does not benefit the state is that the army is too redundant.

sentences.zh: 張浚一軍以川、陝贍之，劉光世一軍以淮、浙贍之，李綱一軍以湖廣贍之，上供之物得至司農、太府者無幾。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun's one army is supplied by Chuan and Shaanxi, Liu Guangshi's one army by Huai and Zhe, Li Gang's one army by Hu and Guang—tribute goods reaching the Ministry of Revenue and Imperial Storehouse are few.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun's one army is supplied by Chuan and Shaanxi, Liu Guangshi's one army by Huai and Zhe, Li Gang's one army by Hu and Guang—tribute goods reaching the Ministry of Revenue and Imperial Storehouse are few.

sentences.zh: 夫強兵不在冗食，今統領家口隨行，一聞賊至，擇精銳者護送老小，其自隨者祗辦走耳，當議者一。

translations.literal: Strong armies do not lie in redundant rations—now commanders' households travel with them; at word of bandits they choose elite troops to escort the old and young, and those who follow themselves only prepare to flee—this should be debated, one.
translations.idiomatic: Strong armies do not lie in redundant rations—now commanders' households travel with them; at word of bandits they choose elite troops to escort the old and young, and those who follow themselves only prepare to flee—this should be debated, one.

sentences.zh: 虜掠婦女，軍中多有，養既不足，寧免作過，當議者二。
