translations.literal: Captive women plundered by the enemy—many are in the army; support is insufficient, how can they avoid misconduct—this should be debated, two.
translations.idiomatic: Captive women plundered by the enemy—many are in the army; support is insufficient, how can they avoid misconduct—this should be debated, two.

sentences.zh: 所至州軍，邀求犒賞，守令憚生事，竭取民以奉之，當議者三。

translations.literal: Wherever they reach prefectures and garrisons they demand reward feasts; prefects and magistrates fear trouble and exhaust the people to serve them—this should be debated, three.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever they reach prefectures and garrisons they demand reward feasts; prefects and magistrates fear trouble and exhaust the people to serve them—this should be debated, three.

sentences.zh: 詭名虛券，隨在批請，枉費官物，當議者四。

translations.literal: False names and empty vouchers—they batch-request wherever they are, wasting official goods—this should be debated, four.
translations.idiomatic: False names and empty vouchers—they batch-request wherever they are, wasting official goods—this should be debated, four.

sentences.zh: 或假關節，或行賄賂，寄名軍籍，規冒功賞，當議者五。

translations.literal: Some borrow credentials, some give bribes, register names on military rolls, scheme for merit rewards—this should be debated, five.
translations.idiomatic: Some borrow credentials, some give bribes, register names on military rolls, scheme for merit rewards—this should be debated, five.

sentences.zh: 願詔有司專意講求，革因循以作士氣，則軍政立。」

translations.literal: I hope an edict will order the relevant offices to focus on inquiry, reform routine to build morale—then military government will be established."
translations.idiomatic: I hope an edict will order the relevant offices to focus on inquiry, reform routine to build morale—then military government will be established."

sentences.zh: 復徽猷閣待制，帥廣。

translations.literal: He was restored as Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall and commanded Guang.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall and commanded Guang.

sentences.zh: 先是，惠州有狂男子聚眾數千，僭號作亂。

translations.literal: Earlier, in Huizhou a mad man gathered several thousand, usurped a title and made rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Huizhou a mad man gathered several thousand, usurped a title and made rebellion.

sentences.zh: 陵入境，誘其徒曾袞，令以功贖罪，不旬日擒之。

translations.literal: When Ling entered the jurisdiction he enticed his follower Zeng Gun, ordering him to redeem guilt by merit; within ten days he captured him.
translations.idiomatic: When Ling entered the jurisdiction he enticed his follower Zeng Gun, ordering him to redeem guilt by merit; within ten days he captured him.

sentences.zh: 在官三年卒，年五十五，贈中大夫。

translations.literal: In office three years he died, age fifty-five, posthumously given Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In office three years he died, age fifty-five, posthumously given Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 有文集十卷。

translations.literal: He had a collected works in ten juan.
translations.idiomatic: He had a collected works in ten juan.

sentences.zh: 陵善言事，奏疏可觀；

translations.literal: Ling was good at speaking on affairs; his memorials are worth viewing;
translations.idiomatic: Ling was good at speaking on affairs; his memorials are worth viewing;

sentences.zh: 然附范宗尹，則謂凡受偽命者皆當進用，臺諫不當復以為言；

translations.literal: yet when attached to Fan Zongyin he then said all who received false appointments should be promoted, and censors should not again speak on it;
translations.idiomatic: yet when attached to Fan Zongyin he then said all who received false appointments should be promoted, and censors should not again speak on it;

sentences.zh: 攻張浚，則謂在蜀失於太專，自陝以西將不知有陛下，君子皆不謂然也。

translations.literal: when attacking Zhang Jun he then said that in Shu he failed by being too autocratic, and west of Shaanxi generals would not know there was Your Majesty—gentlemen all did not consider it so.
translations.idiomatic: when attacking Zhang Jun he then said that in Shu he failed by being too autocratic, and west of Shaanxi generals would not know there was Your Majesty—gentlemen all did not consider it so.

sentences.zh: 幸醫王繼先授榮州防禦使，陵草其制，時論亦以此少之。

translations.literal: The favored physician Wang Jixian was granted Defender of Rong Prefecture; Ling drafted the appointment—contemporary opinion also on this account thought less of him.
translations.idiomatic: The favored physician Wang Jixian was granted Defender of Rong Prefecture; Ling drafted the appointment—contemporary opinion also on this account thought less of him.

sentences.zh: 盧知原

translations.literal: Lu Zhiyuan
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhiyuan

sentences.zh: 盧知原，字行之，湖州德清人。

translations.literal: Lu Zhiyuan, styled Xingzhi, was a native of Deqing in Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhiyuan, styled Xingzhi, was from Deqing in Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 以父任知歙縣，因近臣薦，赴都堂審察，累遷梓州路轉運副使。

translations.literal: Through his father's appointment he became magistrate of She County; because of a near minister's recommendation he went to the Hall for examination, and after accumulated promotions became deputy transport commissioner of the Zizhou route.
translations.idiomatic: Through his father's appointment he became magistrate of She County; because of a near minister's recommendation he went to the Hall for examination, and after accumulated promotions became deputy transport commissioner of the Zizhou route.

sentences.zh: 時承平既久，戎備皆弛，知原招補兵籍，築城亙二十餘里。

translations.literal: At the time peace had long continued and military preparedness was all relaxed; Zhiyuan recruited and supplemented military registers and built walls extending more than twenty li.
translations.idiomatic: At the time peace had long continued and military preparedness was all relaxed; Zhiyuan recruited and supplemented military registers and built walls extending more than twenty li.

sentences.zh: 王黼當國，費出無藝，知原因疏言之，黼怒，罷去。

translations.literal: When Wang Fu held the state, expenditures were boundless; Zhiyuan therefore memorialized on it; Fu was angry and dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Fu held the state, expenditures were boundless; Zhiyuan therefore memorialized on it; Fu was angry and dismissed him.

sentences.zh: 久之，起提點京東刑獄，改江西轉運副使，過闕入奏，徽宗勉之曰：「卿在蜀道，功效甚休。」

translations.literal: After a long time he was recalled as judicial intendant of Jingdong, changed to deputy transport commissioner of Jiangxi; passing the capital he entered audience; Huizong encouraged him saying: "You on the Shu road—your achievement was very fine."
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was recalled as judicial intendant of Jingdong, changed to deputy transport commissioner of Jiangxi; passing the capital he entered audience; Huizong encouraged him saying, "You on the Shu road—your achievement was very fine."

sentences.zh: 遂賜三品服。

translations.literal: He was then granted third-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: He was then granted third-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 先是，綱運阻于重江，吏卒並緣為姦。

translations.literal: Earlier, tribute transport was blocked by heavy rivers; clerks and soldiers all used the opportunity for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, tribute transport was blocked by heavy rivers; clerks and soldiers all used the opportunity for corruption.

sentences.zh: 知原悉意經理，故先諸道上京師，進一官，尋除直秘閣，為江淮荊浙等路發運使。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan managed with full intent, therefore ahead of other routes reached the capital; he was promoted one rank, soon appointed Direct Associate of the Secret Archive and transport commissioner of the Jiang-Huai, Jing, and Zhe routes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiyuan managed with full intent, therefore ahead of other routes reached the capital; he was promoted one rank, soon appointed Direct Associate of the Secret Archive and transport commissioner of the Jiang-Huai, Jing, and Zhe routes.

sentences.zh: 升秘閣修撰，提舉河北。

translations.literal: He was promoted Compiler of the Secret Archive and appointed to administer Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted Compiler of the Secret Archive and appointed to administer Hebei.

sentences.zh: 以言者劾，褫職歸吏部。

translations.literal: Because remonstrators impeached him, his office was stripped and he returned to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Because remonstrators impeached him, his office was stripped and he returned to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，復龍圖閣、知溫州。

translations.literal: When Gaozong took the throne he was restored to the Longtu Hall and appointed prefect of Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong took the throne he was restored to the Longtu Hall and appointed prefect of Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 時葉濃陷建州，揚勍陷處州，知原繕甲兵，增城浚隍，聲勢隱然。

translations.literal: At the time Ye Nong took Jian Prefecture and Yang Qing took Chu Prefecture; Zhiyuan repaired armor and troops, increased walls and dredged moats—his force and reputation were imposing.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Ye Nong took Jian Prefecture and Yang Qing took Chu Prefecture; Zhiyuan repaired armor and troops, increased walls and dredged moats—his force and reputation were imposing.

sentences.zh: 帝東幸，知原繇海道轉粟及金繒十餘萬至台州。

translations.literal: When the emperor went east, Zhiyuan by sea route transported grain and gold and silk of more than a hundred thousand to Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor went east, Zhiyuan by sea route transported grain and gold and silk of more than a hundred thousand to Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 召見，稱獎，擢右文殿修撰、管內安撫使。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience he was praised and promoted to Compiler of the Youwen Hall and pacification commissioner within the jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for audience he was praised and promoted to Compiler of the Youwen Hall and pacification commissioner within the jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 在郡四年，民繪像祠之。

translations.literal: In the prefecture four years—the people painted his image and enshrined him.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefecture four years—the people painted his image and enshrined him.

sentences.zh: 王師討范汝為，召為添差兩浙轉運使。

translations.literal: When the imperial army attacked Fan Ruwei he was summoned as additional-dispatch transport commissioner of the Two-Zhe route.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army attacked Fan Ruwei he was summoned as additional-dispatch transport commissioner of the Two-Zhe route.

sentences.zh: 罷，提舉太平觀。

translations.literal: Dismissed, he was appointed to administer the Taiping Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissed, he was appointed to administer the Taiping Abbey.

sentences.zh: 都督孟庾辟為參謀，改徽猷閣待制、知臨安府。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Meng Geng recruited him as staff officer; he was changed to Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall and prefect of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Meng Geng recruited him as staff officer; he was changed to Awaiting Draftsman of the Huayou Hall and prefect of Lin'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 諫官唐輝言知原為政乖謬，詔復為都督府參謀官。

translations.literal: Remonstrator Tang Hui said Zhiyuan's governance was perverse; an edict restored him as staff officer of the grand coordinator's office.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrator Tang Hui said Zhiyuan's governance was perverse; an edict restored him as staff officer of the grand coordinator's office.

sentences.zh: 章再上，遂以舊職奉祠。

translations.literal: When the memorial came again he was finally given his old office as a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial came again he was finally given his old office as a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 紹興十一年十月卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Shaoxing he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year of Shaoxing he died.

sentences.zh: 弟法原。

translations.literal: Younger brother Fayuan.
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Fayuan.

sentences.zh: 弟 法原

translations.literal: Younger brother Fayuan
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother Fayuan

sentences.zh: 法原，字立之。

translations.literal: Fayuan, styled Lizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Fayuan, styled Lizhi.

sentences.zh: 自知雍丘縣積官太府少卿，賜同上舍出身。

translations.literal: From knowing Yongqiu County through accumulated offices to Vice Director of the Imperial Storehouse, he was granted upper-house origin.
translations.idiomatic: From knowing Yongqiu County through accumulated offices to Vice Director of the Imperial Storehouse, he was granted upper-house origin.

sentences.zh: 使遼還，遷司農卿，賜三品服。

translations.literal: Returning from an embassy to Liao, he was transferred Director of the Directorate of Agriculture and granted third-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Returning from an embassy to Liao, he was transferred Director of the Directorate of Agriculture and granted third-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 為吏部尚書，以官秩次第履歷總為一書，功過殿最，開卷了然，吏不能欺。

translations.literal: As Minister of Personnel he compiled ranks and service records in sequence into one book—merit, fault, grades, and evaluations clear at a glance; clerks could not deceive.
translations.idiomatic: As Minister of Personnel he compiled ranks and service records in sequence into one book—merit, fault, grades, and evaluations clear at a glance; clerks could not deceive.

sentences.zh: 坐王黼累，罷為顯謨閣待制。

translations.literal: Implicated by Wang Fu, he was dismissed as Awaiting Draftsman of the Xianmo Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Implicated by Wang Fu, he was dismissed as Awaiting Draftsman of the Xianmo Hall.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，提舉臨安洞霄宮。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing he was appointed to administer the Dongxiao Abbey in Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing he was appointed to administer the Dongxiao Abbey in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 張浚承制起知夔州，尋為龍圖閣學士、川陝等路宣撫處置副使，進端明殿學士、川陝宣撫副使。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun by special order recalled him as prefect of Kuizhou; soon he was Longtu Academician and deputy grand coordinator and disposition commissioner of the Chuan-Shaanxi routes; he was promoted Academician of the Duanming Hall and deputy grand coordinator of Chuan-Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun by special order recalled him as prefect of Kuizhou; soon he was Longtu Academician and deputy grand coordinator and disposition commissioner of the Chuan-Shaanxi routes; he was promoted Academician of the Duanming Hall and deputy grand coordinator of Chuan-Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 金人攻關輔，叛將史斌陷興州，諸郡多應者。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens attacked the Guan region, rebel general Shi Bin took Xing Prefecture and many prefectures responded.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens attacked the Guan region, rebel general Shi Bin took Xing Prefecture and many prefectures responded.

sentences.zh: 法原命諸將堅壁，言戰者斬，眾以為怯。

translations.literal: Fayuan ordered generals to hold the walls; those who spoke of fighting were beheaded—the crowd thought him cowardly.
translations.idiomatic: Fayuan ordered generals to hold the walls; those who spoke of fighting were beheaded—the crowd thought him cowardly.

sentences.zh: 未幾，河東經制使王燮以乏食班師，法原開關納之，與燮同破斌，復興州。

translations.literal: Before long Hedong commissioner Wang Xie withdrew for lack of food; Fayuan opened the pass and received him; together with Xie they broke Bin and recovered Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Hedong commissioner Wang Xie withdrew for lack of food; Fayuan opened the pass and received him; together with Xie they broke Bin and recovered Xing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 方巨盜充斥，秦、隴叛兵欲窺蜀，法原極意拊循，嚴為備禦，傳檄諸路，人心稍安。

translations.literal: Just then great bandits filled the land; Qin and Long rebel troops wished to spy on Shu; Fayuan devoted himself to soothing and strictly prepared defense, sending proclamations to all routes—hearts gradually settled.
translations.idiomatic: Just then great bandits filled the land; Qin and Long rebel troops wished to spy on Shu; Fayuan devoted himself to soothing and strictly prepared defense, sending proclamations to all routes—hearts gradually settled.

sentences.zh: 視山川險阻分地置將：自洮、岷至階、成，關師古主之，屯通川；

translations.literal: Viewing mountains and rivers' strategic passes he divided territory and placed generals: from Tao and Min to Jie and Cheng, Guan Shigu commanded, stationed at Tongchuan;
translations.idiomatic: Viewing mountains and rivers' strategic passes he divided territory and placed generals: from Tao and Min to Jie and Cheng, Guan Shigu commanded, stationed at Tongchuan;

sentences.zh: 文、龍至威、茂，劉錡主之，屯巴西。

translations.literal: from Wen and Long to Wei and Mao, Liu Qi commanded, stationed at Baxi.
translations.idiomatic: from Wen and Long to Wei and Mao, Liu Qi commanded, stationed at Baxi.

sentences.zh: 前後屢捷，上所倚重。

translations.literal: Before and after repeated victories—the emperor relied on him heavily.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after repeated victories—the emperor relied on him heavily.

sentences.zh: 會兀术攻關為吳玠所敗。

translations.literal: When Wuzhu attacked the pass he was defeated by Wu Jie.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzhu attacked the pass he was defeated by Wu Jie.

sentences.zh: 法原素與玠不睦，玠因奏功訟法原不濟師，不饋糧，不銓錄立功將士。

translations.literal: Fayuan had long been at odds with Jie; Jie therefore reported merit and sued Fayuan for not aiding troops, not supplying grain, and not registering meritorious generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Fayuan had long been at odds with Jie; Jie therefore reported merit and sued Fayuan for not aiding troops, not supplying grain, and not registering meritorious generals and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 帝手詔詰問，法原自辯甚力，上頗不直之，憂恚，卒於軍。

translations.literal: The emperor personally edicted inquiry; Fayuan defended himself very forcefully; the emperor was quite unsympathetic; grieved and indignant, he died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally edicted inquiry; Fayuan defended himself very forcefully; the emperor was quite unsympathetic; grieved and indignant, he died in the army.

sentences.zh: 始，法原為川、陝宣撫使，上從容謂知原曰：「朕方以川、陝付法原。」

translations.literal: At the start, when Fayuan was grand coordinator of Chuan-Shaanxi, the emperor calmly said to Zhiyuan: "I am just now entrusting Chuan-Shaanxi to Fayuan."
translations.idiomatic: At the start, when Fayuan was grand coordinator of Chuan-Shaanxi, the emperor calmly said to Zhiyuan, "I am just now entrusting Chuan-Shaanxi to Fayuan."

sentences.zh: 蓋兄弟皆以材見稱於世，故並用之也。

translations.literal: It was because both brothers were seen in the world for talent, and so both were used.
translations.idiomatic: It was because both brothers were seen in the world for talent, and so both were used.

sentences.zh: 陳桷，字季壬，溫州平陽人。

translations.literal: Chen Jue, styled Jiren, was a native of Pingyang in Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Jue, styled Jiren, was from Pingyang in Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 以上舍貢辟雍。

translations.literal: Through upper-house tribute he entered the Imperial College.
translations.idiomatic: Through upper-house tribute he entered the Imperial College.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，廷對第三，授文林郎、冀州兵曹參軍，累遷尚書虞部員外郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenghe, in palace examination he ranked third; he was granted Gentleman of Letters and military staff officer of Jizhou; after accumulated promotions he became Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Public Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhenghe, in palace examination he ranked third; he was granted Gentleman of Letters and military staff officer of Jizhou; after accumulated promotions he became Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Public Works.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年，提點福建路刑獄。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xuanhe he was judicial intendant of the Fujian route.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Xuanhe he was judicial intendant of the Fujian route.

sentences.zh: 福州調發防秋兵，資糧不滿望，殺帥臣，變生倉卒，吏民奔潰，闔城震駭。

translations.literal: Fuzhou mobilized autumn-defense troops; provisions did not meet expectations; they killed the commander; the mutiny arose in haste; officials and people fled in panic—the whole city was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou mobilized autumn-defense troops; provisions did not meet expectations; they killed the commander; the mutiny arose in haste; officials and people fled in panic—the whole city was shaken.

sentences.zh: 桷入亂兵中，諭以禍福，賊氣沮，邀桷奏帥臣自斃，桷詭從其請，間道馳奏，以前奏不實待罪，朝廷以桷知變，釋之。

translations.literal: Jue entered the mutinous troops, expounded fortune and disaster; the rebels' spirit was dampened; they demanded Jue memorialize that the commander died by his own hand; Jue falsely agreed, then by hidden route galloped to memorialize, awaiting punishment for the prior false report; the court considered Jue understood the change and released him.
translations.idiomatic: Jue entered the mutinous troops, expounded fortune and disaster; the rebels' spirit was dampened; they demanded Jue memorialize that the commander died by his own hand; Jue falsely agreed, then by hidden route galloped to memorialize, awaiting punishment for the prior false report; the court considered Jue understood the change and released him.

sentences.zh: 叛兵既調行，乃道追殺首惡二十餘人，一方以安。

translations.literal: After the rebel troops were mobilized to march, he waylaid and killed more than twenty ringleaders—the region was settled.
translations.idiomatic: After the rebel troops were mobilized to march, he waylaid and killed more than twenty ringleaders—the region was settled.

sentences.zh: 建炎四年五月，復除福建路提刑，尋以疾乞祠，主管江州太平觀。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Jianyan he was again appointed judicial commissioner of the Fujian route; soon citing illness he requested a sinecure and administered the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Jianyan he was again appointed judicial commissioner of the Fujian route; soon citing illness he requested a sinecure and administered the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，召為金部員外郎，升郎中。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing he was summoned as Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and promoted to Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shaoxing he was summoned as Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and promoted to Director.

sentences.zh: 時言事者率毛舉細務，略大利害。

translations.literal: At the time those who spoke on affairs mostly picked minor matters and omitted great benefit and harm.
translations.idiomatic: At the time those who spoke on affairs mostly picked minor matters and omitted great benefit and harm.

sentences.zh: 桷抗言：「今當專講治道之本，修政事以攘敵國，不當以細故勤聖慮如平時也。」

translations.literal: Jue remonstrated forcefully: "Now one should focus on the root of governing the Way, repair government to repel the enemy state—not use minor matters to weary the sacred concern as in normal times."
translations.idiomatic: Jue remonstrated forcefully, "Now one should focus on the root of governing the Way, repair government to repel the enemy state—not use minor matters to weary the sacred concern as in normal times."

sentences.zh: 又言：「刺史縣令滿天下，不能皆得人，乞選監司，重其權，久其任。」

translations.literal: He also said: "Prefects and magistrates fill all under Heaven—not all can be the right men; I beg to select circuit commissioners, weight their power, and lengthen their tenure."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Prefects and magistrates fill all under Heaven—not all can be the right men; I beg to select circuit commissioners, weight their power, and lengthen their tenure."

sentences.zh: 除太常少卿。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 又陳攻守二策，在於得人心，修軍政。

translations.literal: He again presented attack and defense two strategies, lying in winning hearts and repairing military government.
translations.idiomatic: He again presented attack and defense two strategies, lying in winning hearts and repairing military government.

sentences.zh: 五年，除直龍圖閣、知泉州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed Direct Associate of the Longtu Hall and prefect of Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed Direct Associate of the Longtu Hall and prefect of Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 明年，改兩浙西路提刑。

translations.literal: The next year he was changed to judicial commissioner of the Two-Zhe western route.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was changed to judicial commissioner of the Two-Zhe western route.

sentences.zh: 乞置鄉縣三老以厚風俗，凡宮室、車馬、衣服、器械定為差等，重侈靡之禁。

translations.literal: He requested establishing village and county Three Elders to thicken custom; for palaces, carriages, horses, clothing, and implements fix graded ranks—heavy prohibition of extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: He requested establishing village and county Three Elders to thicken custom; for palaces, carriages, horses, clothing, and implements fix graded ranks—heavy prohibition of extravagance.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷福建路轉運副使。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred deputy transport commissioner of the Fujian route.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred deputy transport commissioner of the Fujian route.

sentences.zh: 十年，復召為太常少卿。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was again summoned as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was again summoned as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 適編類徽宗御書成，詔藏敷文閣，桷以為：「舊制自龍圖至徽猷皆設學士、待制，雜壓著令，龍圖在朝請大夫之上，至徽猷在承議郎之上，每閣相去稍遠，議者疑其不倫。

translations.literal: Just then the classified compilation of Huizong's imperial writings was complete; an edict ordered it stored in the Fuwén Hall; Jue considered: "The old system from Longtu to Huayou all established academicians and awaiting draftsmen, mixed ranks recorded in statutes—Longtu above Court Gentleman for Consultation, to Huayou above Gentleman for Discussion; each hall somewhat far apart—discussants doubted it was not ordered.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the classified compilation of Huizong's imperial writings was complete; an edict ordered it stored in the Fuwén Hall; Jue considered, "The old system from Longtu to Huayou all established academicians and awaiting draftsmen, mixed ranks recorded in statutes—Longtu above Court Gentleman for Consultation, to Huayou above Gentleman for Discussion; each hall somewhat far apart—discussants doubted it was not ordered.

sentences.zh: 直敷文閣者綴徽猷則與諸閣小異，除之則班列太卑，欲參酌取中，並為一列，不必相遠，庶幾名位有倫，仰稱陛下嚴奉祖宗謨訓之意。」

translations.literal: Direct Associate of the Fuwén Hall attached to Huayou then differed slightly from other halls; if removed then court rank was too low—I wish to consult and take the middle, combine as one column, need not be far apart, perhaps then names and ranks have order, looking up to match Your Majesty's strict reverence for the ancestors' plans and instructions."
translations.idiomatic: Direct Associate of the Fuwén Hall attached to Huayou then differed slightly from other halls; if removed then court rank was too low—I wish to consult and take the middle, combine as one column, need not be far apart, perhaps then names and ranks have order, looking up to match Your Majesty's strict reverence for the ancestors' plans and instructions."

sentences.zh: 又言：「祫祭用太牢，此祀典之常。

translations.literal: He also said: "The joint sacrifice uses the grand ox—this is normal in the sacrificial canon.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The joint sacrifice uses the grand ox—this is normal in the sacrificial canon.

sentences.zh: 駐蹕之初，未能備禮，止用一羊，乞檢會紹興六年詔旨，復用太牢。」

translations.literal: At the beginning of the temporary halt full rites could not be prepared—only one sheep was used; I beg to check against the sixth year of Shaoxing edict and restore use of the grand ox."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the temporary halt full rites could not be prepared—only one sheep was used; I beg to check against the sixth year of Shaoxing edict and restore use of the grand ox."

sentences.zh: 十一年，除權禮部侍郎，賜三品服。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed Acting Vice Minister of Rites and granted third-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed Acting Vice Minister of Rites and granted third-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 普安郡王出閣，奉詔與吏部、太常寺討論典故。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Pu'an left the inner palace, he received an edict together with the Ministry of Personnel and Court of Imperial Sacrifices to discuss precedents.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Pu'an left the inner palace, he received an edict together with the Ministry of Personnel and Court of Imperial Sacrifices to discuss precedents.

sentences.zh: 桷等議以國本未立，宜厚其禮以繫天下望，乃以《皇子出閣禮例》上之，或以為太重。

translations.literal: Jue and others considered that since the foundation of the state was not yet established, rites should be thick to bind the hope of all under Heaven; they therefore submitted the Ceremonial Precedents for a Prince Leaving the Inner Palace—some thought it too heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Jue and others considered that since the foundation of the state was not yet established, rites should be thick to bind the hope of all under Heaven; they therefore submitted the Ceremonial Precedents for a Prince Leaving the Inner Palace—some thought it too heavy.

sentences.zh: 詔以不詳具典故，專任己意，懷姦附麗，與吏部尚書吳表臣、禮部尚書蘇符、郎官方雲翼、丁仲寧、太常屬王普、蘇籍並罷。

translations.literal: An edict said they did not investigate precedents in detail, relied solely on their own intent, harbored wickedness and clung to factions—together with Minister of Personnel Wu Biaochen, Minister of Rites Su Fu, Directors Fang Yunyi and Ding Zhongning, Court of Imperial Sacrifices staff Wang Pu and Su Ji—all were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said they did not investigate precedents in detail, relied solely on their own intent, harbored wickedness and clung to factions—together with Minister of Personnel Wu Biaochen, Minister of Rites Su Fu, Directors Fang Yunyi and Ding Zhongning, Court of Imperial Sacrifices staff Wang Pu and Su Ji—all were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 尋以桷提舉江州太平觀。

translations.literal: Soon Jue was appointed to administer the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jue was appointed to administer the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十五年，知襄陽府，充京西南路安撫使。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was prefect of Xiangyang Prefecture and concurrently pacification commissioner of the Jingxi southwest route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he was prefect of Xiangyang Prefecture and concurrently pacification commissioner of the Jingxi southwest route.

sentences.zh: 襄、漢兵火之餘，民物凋瘵，桷請於朝，以今之戶數視承平時才二十之一，而賦須尚多，乞重行蠲減。

translations.literal: After the fires of war in Xiang and Han, people and goods were wasted; Jue requested of the court that present household counts were only one twentieth of peaceful times yet levies were still many—I beg heavy renewed reduction.
translations.idiomatic: After the fires of war in Xiang and Han, people and goods were wasted; Jue requested of the court that present household counts were only one twentieth of peaceful times yet levies were still many—I beg heavy renewed reduction.

sentences.zh: 明年，金、房兵叛，桷遣將平之而後以聞。

translations.literal: The next year Jin and Fang troops rebelled; Jue sent generals to pacify them and then reported.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Jin and Fang troops rebelled; Jue sent generals to pacify them and then reported.

sentences.zh: 漢水決溢，漂蕩廬舍，躬率兵民捍築堤岸，賴以無虞。

translations.literal: The Han River burst its banks and flooded dwellings; he personally led soldiers and civilians to defend and build dikes—relying on this there was no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: The Han River burst its banks and flooded dwellings; he personally led soldiers and civilians to defend and build dikes—relying on this there was no trouble.

sentences.zh: 以疾乞祠，除秘閣修撰、提舉江州太平興國宮。

translations.literal: Citing illness he requested a sinecure; he was appointed Compiler of the Secret Archive and administrator of the Taiping Xingguo Abbey in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Citing illness he requested a sinecure; he was appointed Compiler of the Secret Archive and administrator of the Taiping Xingguo Abbey in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，改知廣州，充廣南東路經略安撫使，未至而卒，年六十四。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was changed to prefect of Guangzhou and concurrently grand coordinator and pacification commissioner of the Guangnan east route; before arriving he died, age sixty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was changed to prefect of Guangzhou and concurrently grand coordinator and pacification commissioner of the Guangnan east route; before arriving he died, age sixty-four.

sentences.zh: 桷寬洪醞籍，以誠接物，而恬于榮利。

translations.literal: Jue was broad and generous, cultured and refined, treated people with sincerity, yet was indifferent to glory and profit.
translations.idiomatic: Jue was broad and generous, cultured and refined, treated people with sincerity, yet was indifferent to glory and profit.

sentences.zh: 當秦檜用事，以永嘉為寓里，士之夤緣攀附者，無不躐登顯要。

translations.literal: When Qin Hui held power, taking Yongjia as adopted home, scholars who clung and attached—all without exception leaped to high importance.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin Hui held power, taking Yongjia as adopted home, scholars who clung and attached—all without exception leaped to high importance.

sentences.zh: 桷以立螭之舊，為人主所知，出入頓挫，晚由奉常少卿擢權小宗伯，復以議禮不阿忤意，遽罷，其節有足稱。

translations.literal: Jue as an old associate of the imperial lectern was known to the ruler; entering and leaving he met setbacks; late from Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices he was promoted acting minor Director of the Ancestral Temple; again because discussing rites he did not bend he offended intent and was suddenly dismissed—his integrity is worth praise.
translations.idiomatic: Jue as an old associate of the imperial lectern was known to the ruler; entering and leaving he met setbacks; late from Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices he was promoted acting minor Director of the Ancestral Temple; again because discussing rites he did not bend he offended intent and was suddenly dismissed—his integrity is worth praise.

sentences.zh: 自號「無相居士」。

translations.literal: He styled himself "Layman Without Phase."
translations.idiomatic: He styled himself "Layman Without Phase."

sentences.zh: 有文集十六卷。

translations.literal: He had a collected works in sixteen juan.
translations.idiomatic: He had a collected works in sixteen juan.

sentences.zh: 子汝楫、汝賢、汝諧。

translations.literal: Sons Ruoji, Ruxian, and Ruoxie.
translations.idiomatic: Sons Ruoji, Ruxian, and Ruoxie.

sentences.zh: 孫峴，以詞學擢第，官中書舍人、直學士院。

translations.literal: Grandson Xian, by lexicographic examination advanced in rank, served as Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat and Direct Academician of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Grandson Xian, by lexicographic examination advanced in rank, served as Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat and Direct Academician of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 李璆，字西美，汴人。

translations.literal: Li Qiu, styled Ximei, was a native of Bian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Qiu, styled Ximei, was from Bian.

sentences.zh: 登政和進士第，調陳州教授，入為國子博士，出知房州。

translations.literal: He passed the Zhenghe jinshi examination, was assigned professor of Chen Prefecture, entered as Erudite of the Directorate of Education, and went out as prefect of Fang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the Zhenghe jinshi examination, was assigned professor of Chen Prefecture, entered as Erudite of the Directorate of Education, and went out as prefect of Fang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時既榷官茶，復強民輸舊額，貧無所出，被繫者數百人，璆至，即日盡釋之。

translations.literal: At the time official tea was already monopolized and people were again forced to deliver the old quota; the poor had no means and several hundred were imprisoned; when Qiu arrived he released them all the same day.
translations.idiomatic: At the time official tea was already monopolized and people were again forced to deliver the old quota; the poor had no means and several hundred were imprisoned; when Qiu arrived he released them all the same day.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，廷議將取燕，璆聞之，曰：「百辟卿士，一倡共和，國家安危，其幾在是。」

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe the court debated taking Yan; when Qiu heard he said: "The hundred ministers and great officers—all sing in chorus—the state's safety and danger, its crisis lies here."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuanhe the court debated taking Yan; when Qiu heard he said, "The hundred ministers and great officers—all sing in chorus—the state's safety and danger, its crisis lies here."

sentences.zh: 上疏切諫，大略謂：「太祖以聖武得天下，將士皆百戰之餘，以是而取燕雲，宜易為力。

translations.literal: He submitted a forceful memorial, roughly saying: "Taizu by sacred martial prowess obtained all under Heaven; officers and soldiers were all survivors of a hundred battles—with this to take Yan and Yun should be easy in strength.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a forceful memorial, roughly saying, "Taizu by sacred martial prowess obtained all under Heaven; officers and soldiers were all survivors of a hundred battles—with this to take Yan and Yun should be easy in strength.

sentences.zh: 然趙普輩無敢贊其決者，蓋識天下大勢，且重民命故也。

translations.literal: Yet Zhao Pu and his kind none dared approve the decision—because they recognized the great trend of all under Heaven and moreover valued people's lives.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zhao Pu and his kind none dared approve the decision—because they recognized the great trend of all under Heaven and moreover valued people's lives.

sentences.zh: 今承太平之業，父老幸不識兵，雖不得燕雲地，何闕於漢。」

translations.literal: Now inheriting the enterprise of great peace, the elders fortunately do not know war; though not obtaining Yan and Yun territory, what lacks for Han?"
translations.idiomatic: Now inheriting the enterprise of great peace, the elders fortunately do not know war; though not obtaining Yan and Yun territory, what lacks for Han?"

sentences.zh: 疏奏不省。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted without attention.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted without attention.

sentences.zh: 及燕既平，責監英州清溪鎮。

translations.literal: When Yan was pacified he was punished as supervisor of Qingxi town in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan was pacified he was punished as supervisor of Qingxi town in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明年，赦還為郎，尋試中書舍人。

translations.literal: The next year amnesty restored him as Gentleman; soon he was tested as Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The next year amnesty restored him as Gentleman; soon he was tested as Drafting Attendant of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 建言元祐名臣子孫，久被廢錮，宜少寬之。

translations.literal: He proposed that descendants of Yuanyou worthy ministers, long banned and confined, should be somewhat relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that descendants of Yuanyou worthy ministers, long banned and confined, should be somewhat relaxed.

sentences.zh: 宦官譚稹出師河北，以無功廢，將復進用，璆不肯書行。

translations.literal: Eunuch Tan Zhen went out to Hebei, was dismissed for no achievement, and was about to be again promoted—Qiu refused to draft the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Tan Zhen went out to Hebei, was dismissed for no achievement, and was about to be again promoted—Qiu refused to draft the appointment.

sentences.zh: 會山東盜起，州縣不能制，至河北無見糧，軍士洶洶。

translations.literal: When Shandong bandits arose prefectures and counties could not control them; reaching Hebei there was no visible grain and soldiers were turbulent.
translations.idiomatic: When Shandong bandits arose prefectures and counties could not control them; reaching Hebei there was no visible grain and soldiers were turbulent.

sentences.zh: 璆條奏十事，忤大臣意，罷。

translations.literal: Qiu submitted ten items in sequence, offended the great ministers' intent, and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu submitted ten items in sequence, offended the great ministers' intent, and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 紹興四年，以集英殿修撰知吉州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shaoxing he was Compiler of the Jiying Hall and prefect of Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shaoxing he was Compiler of the Jiying Hall and prefect of Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 江西兵素剽悍，璆始視事，有相挺為亂者，亟捕誅首謀者，撫循其餘，大布恩信，境內遂安。

translations.literal: Jiangxi troops were always fierce; when Qiu first took office some stirred rebellion; he quickly captured and executed the ringleaders, soothed the rest, and broadly spread grace and trust—the territory was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi troops were always fierce; when Qiu first took office some stirred rebellion; he quickly captured and executed the ringleaders, soothed the rest, and broadly spread grace and trust—the territory was then settled.

sentences.zh: 累遷徽猷閣直學士、四川安撫制置使。

translations.literal: After accumulated promotions he was Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall and Sichuan pacification and disposition commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After accumulated promotions he was Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall and Sichuan pacification and disposition commissioner.

sentences.zh: 成都舊城多毀圮，璆至，首命修築。

translations.literal: Chengdu's old walls were mostly ruined; when Qiu arrived he first ordered repair.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu's old walls were mostly ruined; when Qiu arrived he first ordered repair.

sentences.zh: 俄水大至，民賴以安。

translations.literal: Soon great floods came—the people relied on this to be safe.
translations.idiomatic: Soon great floods came—the people relied on this to be safe.

sentences.zh: 三江有堰，可以下灌眉田百萬頃，久廢弗修，田萊以荒。

translations.literal: At the Three Rivers there were weirs that could irrigate downward a million qing of Mei fields—long abandoned unrepaired, fields and wasteland were desolate.
translations.idiomatic: At the Three Rivers there were weirs that could irrigate downward a million qing of Mei fields—long abandoned unrepaired, fields and wasteland were desolate.

sentences.zh: 璆率部刺史合力修復，竟受其利，眉人感之，繪像祠於堰所。

translations.literal: Qiu led prefectural governors together to restore them; ultimately they received the benefit—the people of Mei were grateful and painted his image and enshrined it at the weir site.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu led prefectural governors together to restore them; ultimately they received the benefit—the people of Mei were grateful and painted his image and enshrined it at the weir site.

sentences.zh: 間遭歲饑，民徙，發倉振活，無慮百萬家，治蜀之政多可紀。

translations.literal: Occasionally encountering famine years people migrated; he opened granaries to relieve and sustain—no less than a million households; governing Shu's administration had much worth recording.
translations.idiomatic: Occasionally encountering famine years people migrated; he opened granaries to relieve and sustain—no less than a million households; governing Shu's administration had much worth recording.

sentences.zh: 有《清溪集》二十卷。

translations.literal: He had the Qingxi Collection in twenty juan.
translations.idiomatic: He had the Qingxi Collection in twenty juan.

sentences.zh: 李朴，字先之，虔之興國人。

translations.literal: Li Pu, styled Xianzhi, was a native of Xingguo in Qian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Pu, styled Xianzhi, was from Xingguo in Qian.

sentences.zh: 登紹聖元年進士第，調臨江軍司法參軍，移西京國子監教授，程頤獨器許之。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Shaosheng, was assigned judicial staff officer of Linjiang Army, transferred professor of the Western Capital Directorate of Education—Cheng Yi alone valued and approved him.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the first year of Shaosheng, was assigned judicial staff officer of Linjiang Army, transferred professor of the Western Capital Directorate of Education—Cheng Yi alone valued and approved him.

sentences.zh: 移虔州教授。

translations.literal: He transferred to professor of Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He transferred to professor of Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以嘗言隆祐太后不當廢處瑤華宮事，有詔推鞫。

translations.literal: Because he had once said the Empress Dowager Longyou should not be deposed to dwell at Yaohua Palace, there was an edict to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had once said the Empress Dowager Longyou should not be deposed to dwell at Yaohua Palace, there was an edict to investigate.

sentences.zh: 忌者欲擠之死，使人危言動之，朴泰然無懼色。

translations.literal: Those who envied him wished to squeeze him to death and sent men with alarming words to move him—Pu was calm without fear.
translations.idiomatic: Those who envied him wished to squeeze him to death and sent men with alarming words to move him—Pu was calm without fear.

sentences.zh: 旋追官勒停，會赦，注汀州司戶。

translations.literal: Soon his office was stripped and he was forced to stop; meeting amnesty he was assigned Clerk of Households in Ting Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his office was stripped and he was forced to stop; meeting amnesty he was assigned Clerk of Households in Ting Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 徽宗即位，翰林承旨范純禮自言待罪四十六日，不聞玉音，謂朴曰：「某事豈便於國乎？

translations.literal: When Huizong took the throne, Hanlin Academician Fan Chunli himself said he awaited punishment forty-six days without hearing the jade voice; he said to Pu: "Is such-and-such a matter convenient for the state?
translations.idiomatic: When Huizong took the throne, Hanlin Academician Fan Chunli himself said he awaited punishment forty-six days without hearing the jade voice; he said to Pu, "Is such-and-such a matter convenient for the state?

sentences.zh: 某事豈便於民乎？」

translations.literal: Is such-and-such a matter convenient for the people?"
translations.idiomatic: Is such-and-such a matter convenient for the people?"

sentences.zh: 朴曰：「承旨知而不言，無父風也。」

translations.literal: Pu said: "Academician, knowing yet not speaking—no father's style."
translations.idiomatic: Pu said, "Academician, knowing yet not speaking—no father's style."

sentences.zh: 純禮泣下。

translations.literal: Chunli wept.
translations.idiomatic: Chunli wept.

sentences.zh: 右司諫陳瓘薦朴，有旨召對，朴首言：「熙寧、元豐以來，政體屢變，始出一二大臣所學不同，後乃更執圓方，互相排擊，失今不治，必至不可勝救。」

translations.literal: Right Bureau Remonstrator Chen Guan recommended Pu; there was an order to summon for audience; Pu first said: "Since Xining and Yuanfeng the political body repeatedly changed—at first one or two great ministers' learning differed, afterward they alternately held round and square and mutually attacked; if not remedied now, it will reach beyond saving."
translations.idiomatic: Right Bureau Remonstrator Chen Guan recommended Pu; there was an order to summon for audience; Pu first said, "Since Xining and Yuanfeng the political body repeatedly changed—at first one or two great ministers' learning differed, afterward they alternately held round and square and mutually attacked; if not remedied now, it will reach beyond saving."

sentences.zh: 又言：「今士大夫之學不求諸己，而惟王氏之聽，敗壞心術，莫大於此。

translations.literal: He also said: "Now scholars' learning does not seek it in themselves but only listens to the Wang clan—corrupting mind and character, nothing greater than this.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Now scholars' learning does not seek it in themselves but only listens to the Wang clan—corrupting mind and character, nothing greater than this.

sentences.zh: 願詔勿以王氏為拘，則英材輩出矣。」

translations.literal: I hope for an edict not to be bound by the Wang clan—then outstanding talent will emerge in succession."
translations.idiomatic: I hope for an edict not to be bound by the Wang clan—then outstanding talent will emerge in succession."

sentences.zh: 蔡京惡朴鯁直，他執政三擬官，皆持之不下，復以為虔州教授。

translations.literal: Cai Jing hated Pu's blunt uprightness; other chief ministers three times proposed offices—all held without release; he was again made professor of Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Jing hated Pu's blunt uprightness; other chief ministers three times proposed offices—all held without release; he was again made professor of Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又嗾言者論朴為元祐學術，不當領師儒，罷為肇慶府四會令。

translations.literal: He again incited remonstrators to discuss Pu as Yuanyou learning, unfit to lead teachers—dismissed as magistrate of Sihui in Zhaoqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again incited remonstrators to discuss Pu as Yuanyou learning, unfit to lead teachers—dismissed as magistrate of Sihui in Zhaoqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 有姦民言邑東地產金寶，立額買撲，破田疇，發墟墓，厚賂乃已，朴至，請罷之。

translations.literal: There was a wicked man who said east of the county gold and treasure were produced; fixed quota purchase and monopoly were established, fields broken, tombs excavated—it stopped only after heavy bribes; when Pu arrived he requested abolition.
translations.idiomatic: There was a wicked man who said east of the county gold and treasure were produced; fixed quota purchase and monopoly were established, fields broken, tombs excavated—it stopped only after heavy bribes; when Pu arrived he requested abolition.

sentences.zh: 改承事郎，知臨江軍清江縣、廣東路安撫司主管機宜文字。

translations.literal: Changed to Gentleman for Service, he knew Qingjiang County in Linjiang Army and was chief clerk of the Guangdong pacification commission staff.
translations.idiomatic: Changed to Gentleman for Service, he knew Qingjiang County in Linjiang Army and was chief clerk of the Guangdong pacification commission staff.

sentences.zh: 欽宗在東宮聞其名，及即位，除著作郎，半歲凡五遷至國子祭酒，以疾不能至。

translations.literal: When Qinzong was in the Eastern Palace he heard his name; when he took the throne he was appointed Compiler; in half a year through five promotions he reached Director of the Directorate of Education—citing illness he could not go.
translations.idiomatic: When Qinzong was in the Eastern Palace he heard his name; when he took the throne he was appointed Compiler; in half a year through five promotions he reached Director of the Directorate of Education—citing illness he could not go.

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，除秘書監，趣召，未至而卒，年六十五。

translations.literal: When Gaozong took the throne he was appointed Director of the Secretariat; urgently summoned, before arriving he died, age sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong took the throne he was appointed Director of the Secretariat; urgently summoned, before arriving he died, age sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 贈寶文閣待制，官其子孫二人。

translations.literal: Posthumously given Awaiting Draftsman of the Baowen Hall; two of his sons and grandsons were granted office.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously given Awaiting Draftsman of the Baowen Hall; two of his sons and grandsons were granted office.

sentences.zh: 朴自為小官，天下高其名。

translations.literal: From small office Pu's name was esteemed under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: From small office Pu's name was esteemed under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 蔡京將強致之，俾所厚道意，許以禁從，朴力拒不見，京怒形於色，然終不害也。

translations.literal: When Cai Jing was about to force him to come, he sent men by secret route with kind intent, promising membership in the forbidden secretariat—Pu forcefully refused and would not see him; Jing's anger showed on his face, yet in the end he did not harm him.
translations.idiomatic: When Cai Jing was about to force him to come, he sent men by secret route with kind intent, promising membership in the forbidden secretariat—Pu forcefully refused and would not see him; Jing's anger showed on his face, yet in the end he did not harm him.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎馮熙載欲邂逅見朴，朴笑曰：「不能見蔡京，焉能邂逅馮熙載邪？」

translations.literal: Central Secretariat Vice Minister Feng Xizai wished to meet Pu by chance; Pu laughed and said: "If I cannot see Cai Jing, how can I meet Feng Xizai by chance?"
translations.idiomatic: Central Secretariat Vice Minister Feng Xizai wished to meet Pu by chance; Pu laughed and said, "If I cannot see Cai Jing, how can I meet Feng Xizai by chance?"

sentences.zh: 居官所至有聲。

translations.literal: Wherever he held office there was reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he held office there was reputation.

sentences.zh: 在廣南，止其帥孫竢以文具勤王，不若發常賦助邊。

translations.literal: In Guangnan he stopped his commander Sun Si from paper formalities for rescue-the-throne and urged issuing regular levies to aid the border.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangnan he stopped his commander Sun Si from paper formalities for rescue-the-throne and urged issuing regular levies to aid the border.

sentences.zh: 破漕使鄭良引真臘取安南之計，以息邊患，人稱其智。

translations.literal: He broke Transport Commissioner Zheng Liang's plan to bring Zhenla to take Annan, to quiet border trouble—people praised his wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: He broke Transport Commissioner Zheng Liang's plan to bring Zhenla to take Annan, to quiet border trouble—people praised his wisdom.

sentences.zh: 朴嘗自志其墓曰：「以天為心，以道為體，以時為用，其可已矣。」

translations.literal: Pu once wrote his own tomb inscription: "Take Heaven as heart, take the Way as body, take the time as use—it can stop."
translations.idiomatic: Pu once wrote his own tomb inscription: "Take Heaven as heart, take the Way as body, take the time as use—it can stop."

sentences.zh: 蓋敘其平生云。

translations.literal: This narrates his whole life.
translations.idiomatic: This narrates his whole life.

sentences.zh: 有《章貢集》二十卷行於世。

translations.literal: He had the Zhanggan Collection in twenty juan circulating in the world.
translations.idiomatic: He had the Zhanggan Collection in twenty juan circulating in the world.

sentences.zh: 王庠，字周彥，榮州人。

translations.literal: Wang Xiang, styled Zhouyan, was a native of Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiang, styled Zhouyan, was from Rong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 累世同居，號「義門王氏」。

translations.literal: For generations they dwelt together, called "Righteous Gate Wang Clan."
translations.idiomatic: For generations they dwelt together, called "Righteous Gate Wang Clan."

sentences.zh: 祖伯琪，以義聲著於鄉州。

translations.literal: Grandfather Boqi was renowned in the district and prefecture for righteous reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Grandfather Boqi was renowned in the district and prefecture for righteous reputation.

sentences.zh: 有鹽井籍民煎輸，多至破產，惟有祿之家得免。

translations.literal: There were salt wells registered for people to boil and deliver—many to the point of ruined households; only families with salary were exempt.
translations.idiomatic: There were salt wells registered for people to boil and deliver—many to the point of ruined households; only families with salary were exempt.

sentences.zh: 伯琪請于州，均之官戶，而仕者誣訴之，齎恨以歿。

translations.literal: Boqi requested of the prefecture to equalize among official households; but an officeholder falsely sued him and he died with resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Boqi requested of the prefecture to equalize among official households; but an officeholder falsely sued him and he died with resentment.

sentences.zh: 父夢易，登皇祐第，力成父志，言於州縣不聽，言于刺史，言于三司，三司以聞，還籍沒者三百五十五家，蠲歲額三十萬斤。

translations.literal: Father Mengyi passed the Huangyou examination, forcefully fulfilled his father's will—spoke to prefecture and county without hearing, spoke to the prefect, spoke to the Three Departments; the Three Departments reported it—returned registration to three hundred fifty-five households and remitted the annual quota of three hundred thousand jin.
translations.idiomatic: Father Mengyi passed the Huangyou examination, forcefully fulfilled his father's will—spoke to prefecture and county without hearing, spoke to the prefect, spoke to the Three Departments; the Three Departments reported it—returned registration to three hundred fifty-five households and remitted the annual quota of three hundred thousand jin.

sentences.zh: 嘗攝興州，改川茶運，置茶鋪免役民，歲課亦辦。

translations.literal: He once acted as prefect of Xing Prefecture, changed Sichuan tea transport, established tea shops to exempt corvée from the people—the annual levy was also fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: He once acted as prefect of Xing Prefecture, changed Sichuan tea transport, established tea shops to exempt corvée from the people—the annual levy was also fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 部刺史恨其議不出己，以他事中之，鐫三秩，罷歸而卒。

translations.literal: The route prefect resented that the plan did not come from himself and hit him with other matters—reduced three ranks, dismissed and returned, then died.
translations.idiomatic: The route prefect resented that the plan did not come from himself and hit him with other matters—reduced three ranks, dismissed and returned, then died.

sentences.zh: 母向氏，欽聖憲肅后之姑也。

translations.literal: Mother née Xiang was the paternal aunt of Empress Qinsheng Xiansu.
translations.idiomatic: Mother née Xiang was the paternal aunt of Empress Qinsheng Xiansu.

sentences.zh: 庠幼穎悟，七歲能屬文，儼如成人。

translations.literal: Xiang in youth was sharp and comprehending; at seven he could compose prose, dignified as an adult.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang in youth was sharp and comprehending; at seven he could compose prose, dignified as an adult.

sentences.zh: 年十三，居父喪，哀憤深切，謂弟序曰：「父以直道見擠，母撫柩誓言，期我兄弟成立，贈復父官，乃許歸葬，相與勉之。

translations.literal: At age thirteen, dwelling in father's mourning, grief and indignation were deep; he said to younger brother Xu: "Father was squeezed out for the straight Way; mother by the coffin swore, expecting us brothers to establish ourselves, restore father's office by posthumous grant, then permit return for burial—we encourage one another.
translations.idiomatic: At age thirteen, dwelling in father's mourning, grief and indignation were deep; he said to younger brother Xu, "Father was squeezed out for the straight Way; mother by the coffin swore, expecting us brothers to establish ourselves, restore father's office by posthumous grant, then permit return for burial—we encourage one another.

sentences.zh: 且制科先君之遺意也，吾有志焉。」

translations.literal: Moreover the Decree Examination was our late father's last intent—I have the will."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Decree Examination was our late father's last intent—I have the will."

sentences.zh: 遂閉戶，窮經史百家書傳注之學，尋師千里，究其旨歸。

translations.literal: He then closed his door, exhaustively studied classics, histories, and the hundred schools' commentaries and learning, sought teachers a thousand li, and pursued their essential meaning.
translations.idiomatic: He then closed his door, exhaustively studied classics, histories, and the hundred schools' commentaries and learning, sought teachers a thousand li, and pursued their essential meaning.

sentences.zh: 蚤歲上范純仁、蘇轍、張商英書，皆持中立不倚之論，呂陶、蘇轍皆器重之。

translations.literal: In early years he sent letters to Fan Chunren, Su Zhe, and Zhang Shangying—all holding neutral, non-partisan views; Lü Tao and Su Zhe both valued him.
translations.idiomatic: In early years he sent letters to Fan Chunren, Su Zhe, and Zhang Shangying—all holding neutral, non-partisan views; Lü Tao and Su Zhe both valued him.

sentences.zh: 嘗以《經說》寄蘇軾，謂：「二帝三王之臣皆志於道，惟其自得之難，故守之至堅。

translations.literal: Once he sent Classic Explanation to Su Shi, saying: "Ministers of the Two Emperors and Three Kings all set their will on the Way; because attaining it for themselves is hard, therefore guarding it is to the utmost firm.
translations.idiomatic: Once he sent Classic Explanation to Su Shi, saying, "Ministers of the Two Emperors and Three Kings all set their will on the Way; because attaining it for themselves is hard, therefore guarding it is to the utmost firm.

sentences.zh: 自孔、孟作《六經》，斯道有一定之論，士之所養，反不逮古，乃知後世見《六經》之易，忽之不行也。」

translations.literal: Since Confucius and Mencius made the Six Classics, this Way has fixed discussion; what scholars cultivate does not reach antiquity—then one knows later generations see the Six Classics as easy and neglect to practice them."
translations.idiomatic: Since Confucius and Mencius made the Six Classics, this Way has fixed discussion; what scholars cultivate does not reach antiquity—then one knows later generations see the Six Classics as easy and neglect to practice them."

sentences.zh: 軾復曰：「《經說》一篇，誠哉是言。」

translations.literal: Shi replied: "One essay of Classic Explanation—truly these words."
translations.idiomatic: Shi replied, "One essay of Classic Explanation—truly these words."

sentences.zh: 元祐中，呂陶以賢良方正直言極諫科薦之，庠以宋邦傑學成未有薦者，推使先就，陶聞而益加敬。

translations.literal: In the Yuanyou era Lü Tao by the Worthy and Upright Straightforward Remonstrance examination recommended him; Xiang because Song Bangjie had completed learning but had no recommender, pushed him to go first—Tao on hearing was even more respectful.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yuanyou era Lü Tao by the Worthy and Upright Straightforward Remonstrance examination recommended him; Xiang because Song Bangjie had completed learning but had no recommender, pushed him to go first—Tao on hearing was even more respectful.

sentences.zh: 未幾，當紹聖諸臣用事，遂罷制科，庠歎曰：「命也，無愧先訓，以之行己足矣。」

translations.literal: Before long, when Shaosheng ministers held power, the Decree Examination was abolished; Xiang sighed: "Fate—without failing the late teaching, to practice it in conduct is enough."
translations.idiomatic: Before long, when Shaosheng ministers held power, the Decree Examination was abolished; Xiang sighed, "Fate—without failing the late teaching, to practice it in conduct is enough."

sentences.zh: 崇寧壬午歲，應能書，為首選。

translations.literal: In the renwu year of Chongning he responded to the calligraphy examination and was first choice.
translations.idiomatic: In the renwu year of Chongning he responded to the calligraphy examination and was first choice.

sentences.zh: 京師蝗，庠上書論時政得失，謂中外壅蔽，將生寇戎之患，張舜民見之，歎其危言。

translations.literal: Locusts at the capital—Xiang submitted a memorial discussing gains and losses of current government, saying inner and outer were blocked and bandit-barbarian trouble would arise; Zhang Shunmin on seeing it sighed at his alarming words.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts at the capital—Xiang submitted a memorial discussing gains and losses of current government, saying inner and outer were blocked and bandit-barbarian trouble would arise; Zhang Shunmin on seeing it sighed at his alarming words.

sentences.zh: 下第徑歸，奉親養志，不應舉者八年。

translations.literal: Failing the examination he went straight home, served parents and nurtured aspiration, not responding to examinations for eight years.
translations.idiomatic: Failing the examination he went straight home, served parents and nurtured aspiration, not responding to examinations for eight years.

sentences.zh: 大觀庚寅，行舍法於天下，州復以庠應詔。

translations.literal: In the gengyin year of Daguan the lodge law was implemented throughout the realm; the prefecture again had Xiang respond to the edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the gengyin year of Daguan the lodge law was implemented throughout the realm; the prefecture again had Xiang respond to the edict.

sentences.zh: 庠曰：「昔以母年五十二求侍養，不復願仕，今母年六十，乃奉詔，豈本心乎？」

translations.literal: Xiang said: "Formerly because mother was fifty-two I sought to serve in support and no longer wished office; now mother is sixty and I obey the edict—is this my original heart?
translations.idiomatic: Xiang said, "Formerly because mother was fifty-two I sought to serve in support and no longer wished office; now mother is sixty and I obey the edict—is this my original heart?

sentences.zh: 時嚴元祐黨禁，庠自陳：「蘇軾、蘇轍、范純仁為知己，呂陶、王吉嘗薦舉，黃庭堅、張舜民、王鞏、任伯雨為交遊，不可入舉求仕，願屏居田里。」

translations.literal: At the time the Yuanyou faction ban was strict; Xiang himself stated: "Su Shi, Su Zhe, and Fan Chunren as confidants; Lü Tao and Wang Ji once recommended me; Huang Tingjian, Zhang Shunmin, Wang Gong, and Ren Bocong as associates—I cannot enter examination seeking office; I wish to live hidden in fields and villages."
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Yuanyou faction ban was strict; Xiang himself stated, "Su Shi, Su Zhe, and Fan Chunren as confidants; Lü Tao and Wang Ji once recommended me; Huang Tingjian, Zhang Shunmin, Wang Gong, and Ren Bocong as associates—I cannot enter examination seeking office; I wish to live hidden in fields and villages."

sentences.zh: 以弟序升朝，贈父官，始克葬，葬而母卒。

translations.literal: Because younger brother Xu entered court, father's office was granted by posthumous gift—only then could burial be completed; after burial mother died.
translations.idiomatic: Because younger brother Xu entered court, father's office was granted by posthumous gift—only then could burial be completed; after burial mother died.

sentences.zh: 終喪復舉八行，事下太學，大司成考定為天下第一，詔旌其門。

translations.literal: After mourning ended he again entered the Eight Conducts examination; the matter went down to the Imperial College; the Grand Director determined him first under Heaven; an edict honored his gate.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning ended he again entered the Eight Conducts examination; the matter went down to the Imperial College; the Grand Director determined him first under Heaven; an edict honored his gate.

sentences.zh: 朝廷知其不可屈，賜號「處士」。

translations.literal: The court knew he could not be bent and granted the title "Recluse."
translations.idiomatic: The court knew he could not be bent and granted the title "Recluse."

sentences.zh: 尋改潼川府教授，賜出身及章服，一日四命俱至，竟力辭不受。

translations.literal: Soon changed to professor of Tongchuan Prefecture, granted origin and official robes—four appointments in one day all arrived; he ultimately forcefully declined and did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Soon changed to professor of Tongchuan Prefecture, granted origin and official robes—four appointments in one day all arrived; he ultimately forcefully declined and did not accept.

sentences.zh: 雖處山林，唱酬賦詠，皆愛君憂國之言。

translations.literal: Though dwelling in mountains and forests, in responsive verse and rhapsody all were words of loving the ruler and worrying for the state.
translations.idiomatic: Though dwelling in mountains and forests, in responsive verse and rhapsody all were words of loving the ruler and worrying for the state.

sentences.zh: 太后念其姑，嘗欲官，庠以遜其弟、侄及甥，且以田均給庶兄及前母之姊。

translations.literal: The empress dowager remembering her aunt once wished to grant him office; Xiang yielded to younger brother, nephews, and maternal nephew, and also equally divided fields among half-brothers and elder sister of the former mother.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager remembering her aunt once wished to grant him office; Xiang yielded to younger brother, nephews, and maternal nephew, and also equally divided fields among half-brothers and elder sister of the former mother.

sentences.zh: 庠卒，孝宗諡曰「賢節」。

translations.literal: When Xiang died, Xiaozong posthumously titled him "Worthy Integrity."
translations.idiomatic: When Xiang died, Xiaozong posthumously titled him "Worthy Integrity."

sentences.zh: 序，宣和間以恩幸至徽猷閣直學士。

translations.literal: Xu, in the Xuanhe era through favor reached Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Xu, in the Xuanhe era through favor reached Direct Academician of the Huayou Hall.

sentences.zh: 庠浮沉其間，各建大第，或者謂其晚節隱操少衰云。

translations.literal: Xiang floated among them; each built great mansions—or some say his late-years hidden integrity somewhat declined.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang floated among them; each built great mansions—or some say his late-years hidden integrity somewhat declined.

sentences.zh: 王衣，字子裳，濟南歷城人。

translations.literal: Wang Yi, styled Zishang, was a native of Licheng in Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yi, styled Zishang, was from Licheng in Jinan.

sentences.zh: 以門蔭仕，中明法科，歷深、冀二州法曹掾，入為大理評事，升寺正。

translations.literal: Through hereditary privilege he entered office, passed the Mingfa examination, served as legal clerk of Shen and Ji prefectures, entered as Evaluator of the Grand Court of Justice, and was promoted Court Director.
translations.idiomatic: Through hereditary privilege he entered office, passed the Mingfa examination, served as legal clerk of Shen and Ji prefectures, entered as Evaluator of the Grand Court of Justice, and was promoted Court Director.

sentences.zh: 林靈素得幸，將毀釋氏以逞其私。

translations.literal: Lin Lingsu gained favor and wished to destroy Buddhism to satisfy his private intent.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Lingsu gained favor and wished to destroy Buddhism to satisfy his private intent.

sentences.zh: 襄州僧杜德寶毀體然香，有司觀望靈素意，捕以聞。

translations.literal: Xiangyang monk Du Debao burned his body and lit incense; the officials watched Lingsu's intent and arrested and reported him.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang monk Du Debao burned his body and lit incense; the officials watched Lingsu's intent and arrested and reported him.

sentences.zh: 衣閱之曰：「律自傷者杖而已。」

translations.literal: Yi on reading said: "The law for self-injury is only beating with the staff."
translations.idiomatic: Yi on reading said, "The law for self-injury is only beating with the staff."

sentences.zh: 靈素求內批，坐以害風教竄流之，停衣官，尋予祠。

translations.literal: Lingsu sought an inner draft and seated him on harming custom and teaching, banished and exiled him; Yi's office was stopped, soon given a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Lingsu sought an inner draft and seated him on harming custom and teaching, banished and exiled him; Yi's office was stopped, soon given a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 為陝西都轉運司主管文字、詳定一司敕令所刪定官、通判襲慶府、知濠州，未行，召為刑部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was chief clerk of the Shaanxi chief transport commission, revising officer of the One-Office Statutes Revision Bureau, vice prefect of Xiqing Prefecture, and prefect of Hao Prefecture; before going he was summoned as Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was chief clerk of the Shaanxi chief transport commission, revising officer of the One-Office Statutes Revision Bureau, vice prefect of Xiqing Prefecture, and prefect of Hao Prefecture; before going he was summoned as Outer Section Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 建炎初，為司勳郎中，遷大理少卿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianyan he was Director of the Bureau of Merits and transferred Vice Director of the Grand Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Jianyan he was Director of the Bureau of Merits and transferred Vice Director of the Grand Court of Justice.

sentences.zh: 三年，韓世忠執苗傅、劉正彥，獻俘，檻車幾百兩，先付大理獄，將盡尸諸市。

translations.literal: In the third year Han Shizhong captured Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan, presented captives—caged carts nearly several hundred; first delivered to the Grand Court prison, about to execute all and expose corpses in the market.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year Han Shizhong captured Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan, presented captives—caged carts nearly several hundred; first delivered to the Grand Court prison, about to execute all and expose corpses in the market.

sentences.zh: 衣奏曰：「此曹在律當誅，顧其中婦女有僱買及鹵掠以從者。」

translations.literal: Yi memorialized: "These men by law should be executed, but among them are women who were hired or plundered and followed."
translations.idiomatic: Yi memorialized, "These men by law should be executed, but among them are women who were hired or plundered and followed."

sentences.zh: 高宗矍然曰：「卿言極是，朕慮不及此也。」

translations.literal: Gaozong started and said: "Your words are extremely right—I did not consider this."
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong started and said, "Your words are extremely right—I did not consider this."

sentences.zh: 即詔自傅正彥妻子外皆釋之。

translations.literal: Immediately an edict: except Fu and Zhengyan's wives and children, all were released.
translations.idiomatic: Immediately an edict: except Fu and Zhengyan's wives and children, all were released.

sentences.zh: 范瓊有罪下大理寺，衣奉詔鞫之。

translations.literal: Fan Qiong had guilt and was sent down to the Grand Court of Justice; Yi received an edict to interrogate him.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Qiong had guilt and was sent down to the Grand Court of Justice; Yi received an edict to interrogate him.

sentences.zh: 瓊不伏，衣責以靖康圍城中逼遷上皇，擅殺吳革，迎立張邦昌事，瓊稱死罪。

translations.literal: Qiong did not submit; Yi charged him with forcing the retired emperor to move in the Jingkang siege, arbitrarily killing Wu Ge, and establishing Zhang Bangchang—Qiong acknowledged death guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Qiong did not submit; Yi charged him with forcing the retired emperor to move in the Jingkang siege, arbitrarily killing Wu Ge, and establishing Zhang Bangchang—Qiong acknowledged death guilt.

sentences.zh: 衣顧吏曰：「囚詞服矣。」

translations.literal: Yi turned to the clerks and said: "The prisoner's words have submitted."
translations.idiomatic: Yi turned to the clerks and said, "The prisoner's words have submitted."

sentences.zh: 遂賜死，釋其親屬將佐。

translations.literal: He was then granted death and released his relatives and staff officers.
translations.idiomatic: He was then granted death and released his relatives and staff officers.

sentences.zh: 四年，升大理卿。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted Court Director of the Grand Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted Court Director of the Grand Court of Justice.

sentences.zh: 初，帶御器械王球為龍德宮都監，盡盜本宮寶玉器玩，事覺，帝大怒，欲誅之。

translations.literal: Earlier, Bearer of the Imperial Armory Wang Qiu was superintendent of the Longde Palace and stole all the palace's precious jade and curios; when the matter was discovered the emperor was greatly angry and wished to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Bearer of the Imperial Armory Wang Qiu was superintendent of the Longde Palace and stole all the palace's precious jade and curios; when the matter was discovered the emperor was greatly angry and wished to execute him.

sentences.zh: 衣曰：「球固可殺，然非其所隱匿，則盡為敵有，何從復歸國家乎？」

translations.literal: Yi said: "Qiu certainly can be killed, yet if not for what he hid, all would have become the enemy's—how could they return to the state?"
translations.idiomatic: Yi said, "Qiu certainly can be killed, yet if not for what he hid, all would have become the enemy's—how could they return to the state?"

sentences.zh: 乃寬之。

translations.literal: He was then lenient.
translations.idiomatic: He was then lenient.

sentences.zh: 先是，百司愆戾，付寺劾之，至三問取伏狀，被劾者懼對，莫敢辨。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the hundred offices had faults they were sent to the court for impeachment; up to three interrogations they took confession; the impeached feared facing trial and none dared argue.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the hundred offices had faults they were sent to the court for impeachment; up to three interrogations they took confession; the impeached feared facing trial and none dared argue.

sentences.zh: 衣奏曰：「伏與辨二事也，若一切取伏，是以威迫之，不使自直，非法意也，乞三問未承者，聽辨。」

translations.literal: Yi memorialized: "Confession and argument are two matters; if in all cases confession is taken, that is coercing by authority, not allowing self-justification—not the law's intent; I beg that after three interrogations without admission, argument be permitted."
translations.idiomatic: Yi memorialized, "Confession and argument are two matters; if in all cases confession is taken, that is coercing by authority, not allowing self-justification—not the law's intent; I beg that after three interrogations without admission, argument be permitted."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: It was approved.

sentences.zh: 同詳定一司敕令，刪雜犯死罪四十七條，書成，帝嘉其議法詳明。

translations.literal: Together revising the One-Office Statutes, they deleted forty-seven miscellaneous capital offenses; when the book was complete the emperor praised his discussion of law as detailed and clear.
translations.idiomatic: Together revising the One-Office Statutes, they deleted forty-seven miscellaneous capital offenses; when the book was complete the emperor praised his discussion of law as detailed and clear.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年，權刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaoxing he was Acting Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shaoxing he was Acting Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 二年，除集英殿修撰，奉祠。

translations.literal: In the second year he was appointed Compiler of the Jiying Hall and given a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was appointed Compiler of the Jiying Hall and given a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 既而趙令畤應詔薦之，復召為刑部侍郎，為言者所格。

translations.literal: Soon Zhao Lingzhi by edict recommended him; he was again summoned as Vice Minister of Justice but was blocked by remonstrators.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zhao Lingzhi by edict recommended him; he was again summoned as Vice Minister of Justice but was blocked by remonstrators.

sentences.zh: 四年，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died at home.

sentences.zh: 衣質直和易，持法不阿，議者賢之。

translations.literal: Yi was straightforward and easy in nature, held the law without bending—discussants considered him worthy.
translations.idiomatic: Yi was straightforward and easy in nature, held the law without bending—discussants considered him worthy.

sentences.zh: 論曰：向子諲以相家之子克飭臣節，陳規以文儒之臣有聲鎮守，可謂拔乎流俗者焉。

translations.literal: The discussion says: Xiang Ziyin as a prime minister's son was able to restrain himself in minister's integrity; Chen Gui as a civil Confucian minister had reputation in garrison defense—they can be called those who rose above vulgar custom.
translations.idiomatic: The discussion says: Xiang Ziyin as a prime minister's son was able to restrain himself in minister's integrity; Chen Gui as a civil Confucian minister had reputation in garrison defense—they can be called those who rose above vulgar custom.

sentences.zh: 季陵言事不諱，二盧兄弟並用，以材見稱，陳桷守禮知變，李璆為政有惠，咸足紀焉。

translations.literal: Ji Ling spoke on affairs without avoidance; the two Lu brothers were both employed and seen in the world for talent; Chen Jue kept ritual and knew change; Li Qiu in government had grace—all are worth recording.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Ling spoke on affairs without avoidance; the two Lu brothers were both employed and seen in the world for talent; Chen Jue kept ritual and knew change; Li Qiu in government had grace—all are worth recording.

sentences.zh: 李朴不訹權威，王庠志高而晚節頗衰，王衣明恕而用刑不刻，雖或器識不齊，亦皆不曠其職也歟！

translations.literal: Li Pu did not yield to authority and power; Wang Xiang's aspiration was high yet his late years somewhat declined; Wang Yi was clear in forgiveness and in applying punishment not harsh—though their capacity and insight were not uniform, all also did not neglect their duties!
translations.idiomatic: Li Pu did not yield to authority and power; Wang Xiang's aspiration was high yet his late years somewhat declined; Wang Yi was clear in forgiveness and in applying punishment not harsh—though their capacity and insight were not uniform, all also did not neglect their duties!
